Activity_ghost_enemy_rules:
According to our latest intel, the Invaders have sent special armor masters—"Scylla Legions". Their whereabouts are currently unknown, and they're adept at hiding in the shadows to plunder resources and slaughter Allied troops. In fact, they're planning an ambush on our troops at this very moment. All Guilds have been informed to defend against them.
 
Event Rules:
1. The event lasts for 2 days. After the event starts, Scylla Bases will appear on the map. Peace Shields can't stop the Scylla Legions from attacking your bases. Assemble your forces to defend against them.
2. R4 and R5 members of a Guild can start the event in the event interface. You can choose to start immediately or at a scheduled time. It's recommended that you start the event after fully discussing with your Guild members and choosing a time when most members are active.
3. After the event starts, the Scylla Bases will send out 25 waves of Scylla Legions to attack Guild members. Waves 5/10/15/20/25 are Elite Troops. Don't forget to reinforce your Guild members.
4. Each wave of Scylla Legions will randomly attack 10 Guild members first, and then after a certain period, another 10 members, until all members have been attacked. Then the next wave will begin.
5. If a player has failed to defend against the Scylla Legions two times in a row, they will stop attacking that player.
6. If 20% of Guild members have defended against 20 waves, the difficulty level of the event next time will increase by 1 star. If 20% of Guild members only defended against 5-20 waves, the difficulty level will remain the same.
 
Rewards Info:
1. Successfully defending against a wave will earn you Wave Rewards.
2. Defense Rewards can be earned after reaching the corresponding Individual Points and Guild Point requirements.
3. The top 100 players can get extra Leaderboard Rewards (Individual Points).
4. All members from the top 10 Guilds can also get extra Leaderboard Rewards (Guild Points).
 
Notes:
1. Scylla Legions won't inflict any unit losses.
2. Reinforcing Guild members to defend against more Scylla Legion waves will also earn you Individual Points and Guild Points.
3. If you quit the previous Guild where you completed the event, Guild points displayed in the event settlement interface will be the points of the previous Guild; if you join in a new Guild, the final Guild ranking rewards will be based on how you rank in the new Guild.
4. Scylla Legions won't attack Guild members that haven't logged in for 3 days in a row.
5. If you teleport your base after the event starts, Scylla Legions will stop attacking you right away, and the event ends for you.
6. Guild members under attack will show in [Attack Details] on the event interface.
7. When you are under attack, you can tap the button [Ask for Help], and your message will be sent to your Guild channel.
8. Each commander can only participate in this event once.
9. When a commander leaves the Guild during the event, the Guild points displayed on the event results screen are those of the original Guild. When the commander joins a new Guild, the final Guild ranking rewards will be issued based on the ranking of the new Guild.

Activity_valentine_guild_subtitle: Complete the event to obtain Chloe and limited Outfits!
Activity_valentine_guild_info: A famous poet once said, “But by now, my desire and will were turned, like a balanced wheel rotated evenly by the love that moves the sun and other stars.” Love is a poem and the sun is in our life, and it can be found everywhere. Valentine's Day is just around the corner, and we've prepared tons of interesting events and amazing rewards for you. Tap the upper left corner to see more details.
Activity_valentine_guild_rule:
The Valentine event is divided into four parts, Sweet Affection, Cupid’s Call, Words of Roses, and Kiss of Cupid.

Sweet Affection:
Complete daily missions to obtain event items and amazing rewards.

Cupid’s Call:
Gather resources, defeat Invaders, and collect resources on your base to get special items needed for the events.

Kiss of Cupid:
Defeat Invaders in a row to obtain points, and claim amazing ranking rewards.

Words of Roses:
Cultivate your very own rose and win a Limited Officer Outfit!
Activity_valentine_task_rules:
1. This event will last for 8 days. In the first 5 days, 3 side events will be unlocked each day. You can obtain Roses by completing missions in the side events in the first 7 days.
2. On day 8, you won’t be able to complete missions, but extra chest rewards will be available for you to claim. Rewards are based on the number of missions you completed over the previous days.
3. Roses can be used in the Words of Roses event.
Activity_valentine_rose_rules:
1. Use Roses to decorate your Rose Arrangement and level it up to claim corresponding rewards.
2. Unlock the advanced Rose Arrangement to get extra rewards.
3. Each decoration has a chance to trigger Crit mode to add more XP to your Rose Arrangement.
4. When your Rose Arrangement reaches Lv25. You can exchange excess Roses for Medium Resource Chests at a 1:1 ratio.
5. Rewards at each stage can be claimed only once. This event won't be reset during this period.
Activity_valentine_rose_unlock_tips: Unlock the advanced Rose Arrangement for more rewards!
Activity_valentine_rose_popup_tips: Get Roses in the following ways
Activity_valentine_drop_rules:
1. During the event, players have a chance to find Rose Boxes when collecting resources in their bases, gathering resources, or defeating Invaders on the map. Any Rose Boxes found will be sent via mail.
2. Open a Rose Box to obtain Roses.
3. Roses can be used to decorate during the Words of Roses event.

Activity_valentine_kiss_rules:
1. During the event, defeat Invaders to earn points.
2. Accumulate points by defeating Invaders consecutively (without visiting any resource point, City, base, Guild building, etc). The points will be reset to zero if you return to Base.
3. The highest number of points you accumulated in a single trip will be taken as your final score. You can claim a tiered reward after meeting certain score requirements.
4. The system will rank all Commanders on the server based on their event points, and the top 100 Commanders on the server will receive extra rankings rewards after the event ends.
Tip: Save Action Points by defeating Invaders consecutively without returning to your Base!

Activity_easter_guild_subtitle: Complete the event and win epic outifts for Lilith!
Activity_easter_guild_info: The warm spring breeze brings everything back to the earth. The green grass buds and blooming lilies symbolize activity and vitality, and Easter is fast approaching. We've prepared limited edition outfits and plenty of rewards to celebrate this festival, and exciting Easter events are coming! Tap on the icon in the upper right corner to view.
Activity_easter_guild_rule:
The series of Easter events is divided into five parts: the Rebirth of All Things, the Day of Revival, Ode to Spring, Easter Eggs, and the Gift of Rebirth. 
 
 Rebirth of All Things (April 10-April 17):
 Receive holiday items and generous rewards by completing daily missions. 
 
 Day of Revival (April 10-April 16):
 Collect resources, defeat the invading enemy, collect resources in the base, and gather the items required for the Easter Egg events Resurrection - Easter Egg Paint. 
 
 Ode to Spring (April 11-April 12):
 Successively defeat the invading enemy and you will earn points to receive generous ranking rewards. 
 
 Easter Eggs (April 10-April 16):
 Make Easter eggs with your allies and receive rewards of great value! 
 
 Gift of Rebirth (April 10-April 17):
 Use the collected holiday items to redeem gifts. Don't miss out on the epic outifts for Lilith!
Activity_easter_task_rules:
1. This event will last 8 days, during the first 5 days of which the system will unlock 3 sideline activities every day, and during the first 7 days a commander can obtain the "Easter Egg Paint" and "Golden Easter Egg" items by completing the tasks in the sideline interaction. 
 2. On the 8th day of the event, commanders will no longer be able to continue the tasks, but will be able to claim additional treasure chest rewards, which will be calculated based on the number of tasks completed successfully. 
 3. The "Easter Egg Paint" can be used in the Easter Egg Resurrection Events, and the "Golden Easter Eggs" can be used in the Gift of Rebirth events.
Activity_easter_egg_rules:
1. Easter eggs can be upgraded if you add Easter egg paint or spend gold coins on coloring. When the Easter eggs reach the designated level, all members of the Guild will receive corresponding rewards, which will be sent via email. 
 2. Each time you add Easter egg paint to an egg, you will get an egg fragment. This is valid even after the egg reaches the top level. 
 3. Each time you use your gold coin to color your Easter egg, you will get a golden Easter egg. This is valid even after the egg reaches the top level. 
 4. The golden Easter eggs and Easter egg fragments can be used to redeem various rewards, including Lilith's epic outfits, during the "Gift of Rebirth" events. 
 5. Each time you add paint to or use your gold coin to color an egg, there is a probability of a 'critical' effect, adding more experience value to the Easter egg. 
 6. The contribution list will show the contribution values of all commanders in the Guild in this event. Each time paint is added or a gold coin is used, a commander will earn 1 point in contribution value.
Activity_easter_egg_get_1_des: Obtain it by participating in the Rebirth of All Things events
Activity_easter_egg_get_2_des: Obtain it by participating in the Day of Revival events
Activity_easter_egg_get_3_des: Obtain it by participating in the Ode to Spring events
Activity_easter_drop_rules:
1. During the event, when all the commanders collect resources within and outside the city or defeat an invading enemy, there is a certain probability for each of them to find Easter egg paint, which will be sent by mail.
 2. Easter egg paint can be used to upgrade the Easter eggs in the "Easter Egg" events.

Activity_easter_drop_resource_gathering_: Collecting resources in the open field will give you a chance to obtain Easter Egg Paint
Activity_easter_drop_defeat_enemy_des: Defeating any level of invaders will give you a chance to obtain Easter Egg Paint
Activity_easter_exchage_rules:
1. Use "Easter Egg Fragments" and "Golden Easter Eggs" to redeem various gifts in this event! 
 2. Participate in the series of Easter events and you will receive the above redeemable items.

Activity_celebrate_guild_subtitle: Complete this event to get Angelica and the limited edition Haute Couture outfits!
Activity_celebrate_guild_info: A new journey is about to begin! Commanders will face new challenges and missions in what is certain to be an interesting adventure! In celebration of this new chapter we have prepared new limited edition outfits and generous gifts! Tap on the upper right corner to get more details.
Activity_celebrate_guild_rule:
The new outfit celebration event is divided into four parts: Rewards day, Lucky Times, Day of Battle and Gifts Phase.
 
 Rewards Day:
 Get specific items and rewards by completing daily tasks.
 
 Lucky Times:
 Collect resources, defeat the invaders, collect resources within the base and get the required items for the event: four-leaf clover.
 
 Day of battle:
 Beat the invader armies to earn points and receive generous ranking rewards.
 
 Gifts Phase:
 Add lucky charms to your gifts and get great rewards for the level you have reached!
Activity_celebrate_task_rules:
1. This event will last a total of 8 days. During the first 5 days 3 side missions will be unlocked every day. For the first 7 days Commanders can get the" four-leaf clover "item by completing these side missions.
 2. On the 8th day of the event side missions will no longer be available but commanders will be able to receive additional reward chests, which will be calculated based on the number of successfully completed missions.
 3. The four-leaf clovers can be used in the gift event.
Activity_celebrate_gift_rules:
1. Use the clover to increase the level of the gift. Once the gift reaches the specified level you can receive the corresponding reward.
 2. Unlock premium gifts for additional rewards.
 3. Every time commanders use a four-leaf clover there is a chance of a 'critical' effect, adding more value to the gift.
 4. Once the gift reaches level 25, commanders can trade the remaining four-leaf clovers 1:1 for resource boxes.
 5. Each award can only be collected once. The event will not be reset.
Activity_celebrate_gift_unlock_tips: Unlock premium gifts to get more rewards!
Activity_celebrate_drop_rules:
1. During the event commanders will have a certain chance to find a four-leaf clover gift box while collecting resources in and outside the city or after defeating an army of the invaders.
 2. Open the four-leaf clover gift box to get four-leaf clover.
 3. The four-leaf clovers can be used in the gift event.

Activity_celebrate_drop_resource_gatheri: Collect resources outside the city for a chance to get a four-leaf clover gift box.
Activity_celebrate_drop_defeat_enemy_des: Defeat an invader army of any level for a chance to get a four-leaf clover gift box.

Activity_motherday_guild_info: <color=#000000>Mother's Day is here! The love of our mother follows us everywhere, carries us forward and warms our hearts. To celebrate the occasion, we have a new limited edition base decorations and tons of rewards. So join the event now! Tap the upper right corner of the screen for details.</color>
Activity_motherday_guild_rule:
The Mother's Day event is divided into five parts: Love beyond words, Flowers of Affection, Gratitude, Loving Appreciation, and the gifts phase.
 
 Wordless love (May 09 - May 16):
 Get specific items and generous rewards by completing daily tasks.
 
 Gratitude (May 09 - May 15):
 Collect resources inside or outside the base and defeat the invaders to get water drop items for the Flowers of Affection event
 
 Loving Appreciation (May 10 - May 11):
 Defeat the invader armies to earn points and receive generous ranking rewards.
 
 Flowers of Affection (May 09 - May 15):
 Create beautiful flower vases with your allies and receive great rewards!
 
 Gifts phase (May 09 - May 16):
 Trade the event items for rewards and don't miss the special base decoration!
Activity_motherday_task_rules:
1. This event will last a total of 8 days. During the first 5 days 3 side missions will be unlocked every day. For the first 7 days Commanders can get "Water Drops” and “Letters” items by completing these side missions.
 2. On the 8th day of the event side missions will no longer be available but commanders will be able to receive additional reward chests, which will be calculated based on the number of successfully completed missions.
 3. The water drops can be used in Flowers of Affection event. Letters can be used during the gifts phase.
Activity_motherday_flower_rules:
1. Flower vases can be upgraded by spending water drops or gold coins. When the vase reaches the designated level, all members of the Guild will receive corresponding rewards. The rewards will be sent by email.
 2. Each time you add water drops to a vase you will get a flower. This effect continues even after the vase reaches maximum level.
 3. Each time you use your gold coin to decorate a vase, you will get a letter. This effect continues even after the vase reaches maximum level.
 4. During the gifts phase flowers and letters can be used to redeem various rewards, including the limited edition base decoration.
 5. Each time you use a water drop or gold coins for the vases, there is a chance for a 'critical' effect, adding more experience points to the vase.
 6. The contribution list will show the contribution values of all commanders in the Guild in this event. Each time a water drop or a gold coin is used, a commander will earn 1 point in contribution value.
Activity_motherday_drop_rules:
1. During the event commanders will have a certain chance to find water drop items while collecting resources in and outside the city or after defeating an army of the invaders. Water drop items will be received by email.
 2. Water drops can be used to raise the level of flower vases in the "Flowers of Appreciation" event.

Activity_motherday_drop_resource_gatheri: Collect resources outside the city for a chance to get water drops.
Activity_motherday_drop_defeat_enemy_des: Defeat an invader army of any level for a chance to get water drops.
Activity_motherday_exchage_rules:
1. Redeem flowers and letters received in this event for a variety of gifts!
 2. Take part in the Mother's Day series to get these special event items.

Activity_Dead_Empire_guild_subtitle: Complete the event to win a Limited Outfit for Katherine!
Activity_Dead_Empire_guild_info: The world is at the brink of destruction, and we must unite as one in order to vanquish the Dead Empire and prevent the apocalypse! Complete a series of events to get Katherine and a Limited Outfit for her! Tap "Details" at top right for more info.
Activity_Dead_Empire_guild_rule:
The Dead Empire Counterattack event is divided into five parts: Counterattack Prep, Collect Military Supplies, Warrior Camp, Prevent the Apocalypse, and Counterattack Dawn.

Counterattack Prep (Aug 12 - Aug 19):
Complete Daily Missions to get event items and lots of rewards.

Collect Military Supplies (Aug 12 - Aug 18):
Gather resources, defeat Invaders, and collect resources inside your Base to get the event items needed for Warrior Camp—Military Supplies.

Prevent the Apocalypse (Aug 13 - Aug 14):
Continue defeating Invaders to earn points and claim abundant rankings rewards.

Warrior Camp (Aug 12 - Aug 18):
Build Warrior Camps together with your Guild mates to claim amazing rewards!

Counterattack Dawn (Aug 12 - Aug 19):
Exchange the collected event items for gifts, and don't miss out on Katherine's Limited Outfit!
Activity_Dead_Empire_task_rules:
1. This event will last a total of 8 days. During the first 5 days, 3 side missions will be unlocked every day. For the first 7 days, Commanders can get "Military Supplies" and "Dawn Commemorative Coins" by completing these side missions.
2. On the 8th day of the event, side missions will no longer be available, but Commanders will be able to receive additional reward chests based on the number of successfully completed missions.
3. Military Supplies can be used in the Warrior Camp event, and Dawn Commemorative Coins can be used in the Counterattack Dawn event.
Activity_Dead_Empire_Camp_rules:
1. Use Military Supplies or spend Gold to upgrade the level of camp weapons. After the camp weapons reach a certain level, all Guild members will receive the corresponding rewards, which will be sent via mail.
2. Every time you use Military Supplies to upgrade the camp weapons, you will get a Dawn Commemorative Coin, which will remain valid even after your weapons reach their maximum level.
3. Every time you use Gold to upgrade the camp weapons, you will get a Warrior Commemorative Coin, which will remain valid even after your weapons reach their maximum level.
4. Dawn Commemorative Coins and Warrior Commemorative Coins can be used to redeem for rewards in the Counterattack Dawn event, including Katherine's Limited Outfit.
5. Every time you use Military Supplies or Gold, there's a chance to "crit", which adds even more EXP to the weapons.
6. The Contribution List will show the contributions of every Commander in the Guild, and each time a Commander uses Military Supplies or Gold, it will count as 1 Contribution Point.
Activity_Dead_Empire_drop_rules:
1. During the event, Commanders will have a certain chance to find Military Supplies from gathering resources inside or outside the base, or by defeating Invaders. Military Supplies will be sent via mail.
2. Military Supplies can be used to upgrade the camp weapons in the Warrior Camp event.

Activity_autumn_guild_subtitle: Complete missions to win an Autumn Leaves Limited Base Decoration!
Activity_autumn_guild_info: Imperceptibly but inevitably, the seasons change. A dropping leaf signals the start of autumn. Golden rays of sunlight shine down, as warm and tranquil as the soft autumn breeze. To celebrate, we've prepared an autumn-themed base decoration as well as plentiful rewards, so hurry to participate!
Activity_autumn_guild_rule:
The Autumn Leaves events are divided into five parts: Golden Autumn, Blessing Preparation, Wild Commander, Autumn Blessing, and Harvest Celebration.

Golden Autumn:
Complete daily missions to get items and generous rewards.

Blessing Preparation:
Gather resources, defeat Invaders, and collect resources in your base to get special items needed for the Autumn Blessing event: Blessing Ribbons.

Wild Commander:
Consecutively defeat Invaders to earn points and claim plentiful rankings rewards.

Autumn Blessing:
Pray for blessings with your Guild mates to claim great rewards!

Harvest Celebration:
Exchange the collected items for gifts, and don't miss out on the autumn-themed Limited Base Decoration!
Activity_autumn_task_rules:
1. This event will last a total of 8 days. During the first 5 days, 3 side missions will be unlocked every day. For the first 7 days, Commanders can get "Fortune Pouches" and "Blessing Ribbons" by completing these side missions.
2. On the 8th day of the event, side missions will no longer be available, but commanders will be able to receive additional reward chests based on the number of successfully completed missions.
3. Blessing Ribbons can be used in the Autumn Blessing event, and Fortune Pouches can be used in the Harvest Celebration event.
Activity_autumn_tree_rules:
1. Use Blessing Ribbons or spend Gold to upgrade the Maple Tree. After the Maple Tree reaches a certain level, all Guild members will receive the corresponding rewards, which will be sent via mail.
2. Every time you use a Blessing Ribbon, you will get a Maple Leaf, which will remain valid even after your Maple Tree reaches its maximum level.
3. Every time you use Gold, you will get a Fortune Pouch, which will remain valid even after your Maple Tree reaches its maximum level.
4. Maple Leaves and Fortune Pouches can be used to redeem for rewards in the Harvest Celebration event, including an autumn-themed Limited Base Decoration.
5. Every time you use a Fortune Pouch or Gold, there's a chance to "crit", which adds even more EXP to the Maple Tree.
6. The Contribution List will show the contributions of every Commander in the Guild, and each time a Commander uses a Fortune Pouch or Gold, it will count as 1 Contribution Point.
Activity_autumn_drop_rules:
1. During the event, players have a chance to find Blessing Ribbons when collecting resources in their bases, gathering resources, or defeating Invaders on the map. The Blessing Ribbons will enter your Items directly.
2. Blessing Ribbons can be used in the Autumn Blessing event.
Activity_autumn_drop_resource_production: Collect resources inside the base for a chance to get Blessing Ribbons
Activity_autumn_drop_resource_gathering_: Gather resources outside the base for a chance to get Blessing Ribbons

Activity_Dead_Empire_kill_rules:
1. During the event, defeat Invaders to earn points.
2. Accumulate points by defeating Invaders consecutively (without returning to Base or entering any buildings on the map). The points will be reset to zero if you return to Base or enter any other building.
3. The highest number of points you accumulated in a single trip will be taken as your final score. You can claim a tiered reward after meeting certain score requirements.
4. The system will rank all Commanders on the server based on their event points, and the top 100 Commanders on the server will receive extra rankings rewards after the event ends.
Tip: Save Action Points by defeating Invaders consecutively without returning to your Base!

Lv.1–5 Invaders = 1 point
Lv.6–10 Invaders = 2 points
Lv.11–15 Invaders = 3 points
Lv.16–20 Invaders = 5 points
Lv.21–25 Invaders = 10 points

Activity_TransServer_Limit_Detail:
Dear sir, you must meet the following conditions before you can be transferred to this war zone: 
 
 1. Your HQ <color=#ffb726> is at Level 16 or above </color>
 2. You have enough <color=#ffb726> Transfer Command Letters </color>
 3. All the marching military columns are in an idle state
 4. Neither your city nor your troops are in a combat state
 5. You do not belong to any Guild
 6. The resources you carry does not exceed your own warehouse protection limit
 7. After each transfer, you will need to wait <color=#ffb726> 30 days </color> before you can be transferred again
8. Your power cannot exceed the <color=#ffb726> power limit </color> of the target zone.
 
 After successful transfer, the game will restart automatically, and your city will appear in a random location in the target war zone after you enter the game.

Activity_summer_guild_rule:
The Summer event is divided into four parts: Passionate Summer, Summer Party, Starlit Skies, Summer Night.
 
Passionate Summer (June 15-June 22):
 Get event items and generous rewards by completing daily tasks.
 
Summer Party (June 15-June 21):
 Collect resources and defeat the invaders to get the Midsummer Boxes. Those boxes contain branches which are needed for the Summer Night event.
 
Starlit Skies (June 16-June 17):
 Defeat the invaders to get points and receive generous rewards.
 
Summer Night (June 15-June 21):
 Add your branches to the campfire and receive generous rewards based on the level you reached.
Activity_summer_task_rules:
1. This event will last a total of 8 days. During the first 5 days 3 side missions will be unlocked every day. For the first 7 days. Commanders can get "Branches" by completing these side missions.

 3. The branches can be used in Summer Night event.

 4. Commanders on the server will be ranked based on their points. The top 100 Commanders can also receive extra ranking rewards after the event ends.

 Lv1-5 Invaders = 1 Point

Event Rules
1. Spin a certain number of times to get bonus rewards! Tap the chest at top left to claim them.
2. Bonus rewards won't be reset when the participation chances are reset every day. You can claim all bonus rewards after reaching the corresponding requirements during the event.
3. When you spin the slot machine, the rollers will begin to spin. If any 1 of the items in the center line is different from the other 2, then you do not obtain the item.
4. You will get a Surprise Supply every time you spin, whether you win or not.

 Event Rules:
 1. You can spend Picks to open boxes in the Abandoned Arsenal during the event, with each box containing rewards.
 2. You must select a final reward on a floor in the Abandoned Arsenal before you can search for rewards there. Upon earning the final reward of a floor, you immediately unlock the next floor.
 (Having earned the final reward on the final floor, you can continue to open other unopened boxes)
 3. You can change the final reward of a floor at any time until you've claimed it without affecting your search progress.
 4. Each 5th floor contains even greater rewards.
 5. You retain Picks after the event ends, and you can use these in future events.

Activity_qa_rule:
A powerful commander needs not only strong command skills but also a wealth of knowledge.
1. The event is open for a limited time, lasting three days, with a new stage opening each day.
2. Stage one has no time limit, commanders can carefully think before answering, and can continue to answer even if they answer incorrectly.
3. Stage two has a time limit for answering, commanders need to answer within the specified time. If you quit halfway or answer incorrectly, you can still continue to answer.
4. Stage three adds a new restriction on the basis of stage two: after answering incorrectly three times, stage three ends, please answer carefully, commanders.

Activity_b2_eagle_action_rules:
The Allied Ninth Air Force transport aircraft formation was ambushed by the enemy while on a mission. To protect the supplies from being destroyed, the supplies were airdropped to a safe area, and most of the transport aircraft failed to reach their destination. The Allies decided to dispatch the AD-3W carrier-based early warning aircraft to rescue survivors, search for transport aircraft wreckage, and recover lost supplies.

Rescue Operation:
1. During the event, suspicious locations can be discovered through radar scans. Dispatch reconnaissance aircraft to recover supplies and rescue transport aircraft.
2. Each scan consumes 1 early warning aircraft fuel. On the first day, 3 fuels can be obtained for free. One fuel is restored every 10 minutes, with a daily limit of 10.
3. Recovering different levels of airdrop supplies can yield different levels of item rewards.
4. Rescuing transport aircraft can yield top airdrop supplies and secret document fragments. Collecting 3 types of secret document fragments can be exchanged for a complete secret document, which can be opened for generous rewards.
5. Killing invaders has a chance to obtain more early warning aircraft fuel.
6. Upgrading the main city level can unlock more advanced carrier-based radars. Advanced radars have a high probability of discovering advanced supplies and transport aircraft.
7. Scientists have recently improved the carrier-based radar, allowing us to explore more types of suspicious targets.

Outstanding Contribution:
1. Commanders who make outstanding contributions in rescue operations can obtain more rewards through the leaderboard.
2. After the event ends, leaderboard rewards will be uniformly distributed via mail.

Activity_Return_guide_rule:
The Welcome Back event series consists of 4 parts.

Return Quests:
Complete daily quests to earn generous rewards.

Return Treasure:
Gather resources, defeat invading forces, and collect resources from your base to obtain "Keys of Return".

Return Wheel:
Earn a large number of "Return Coins".

Return Shop:
Redeem amazing rewards!
Activity_Return_task_rule:
1. The event lasts for a total of 7 days. Each day, the system will unlock that day's event quests. During the first 6 days, Commanders can earn event rewards by completing side quests.
2. On the 7th day of the event, Commanders will no longer be able to progress on quests, but will be able to claim an additional chest reward. The reward content will be calculated based on the number of quests successfully completed.
Activity_Return_drop_rule:
During the event, Commanders have a chance to obtain the event item "Key of Return" when collecting resources in the city, gathering resources outside the city, and defeating Invaders. After reaching the daily acquisition limit, you can continue to obtain it the next day.

"Key of Return" can be used in the "Return Wheel" event.
Activity_Return_wheel_rule:
1. After spinning the wheel a certain number of times, you can get bonus rewards! Tap the chest on the upper left corner to claim them.
2. Bonus rewards won't be reset along with the reset of daily spin chances. You can claim all bonus rewards after reaching the corresponding requirements during the event.
3. Your chances will be reset at UTC 00:00 daily.
Activity_Return_guide_text: Commander, welcome home! We have prepared fun events and generous rewards for you. Come and join in!
Activity_Return_task_resource: Obtainable by participating in the "Return Quests" event.

Activity_item_AutumnHunt2026_whistle_d: An Autumn Hunt event item. Use it to activate the Autumn Hunt Supply Machine.
Activity_rule_AutumnHunt2026_slot:
The Autumn Hunt is on! Sound your Hunting Whistle and spin for officer badges and upgrade rewards!
Join the hunt over 7 days and try your luck with 1 free spin every server day.
Use 1 Hunting Whistle for a single spin or 5 for five spins. Reach 10, 30, 60, 90 and 150 total spins to claim extra milestone rewards. Aim for the generous final milestone at 150 spins!
Free spins count toward your progress. Each milestone can be claimed once. Keep spinning after the 150-spin milestone, up to 365 spins for the entire event.
Daily free spins reset with the server day. No exchange is available after the event, so join in and claim your rewards in time!
Activity_rule_AutumnHunt2026_supply: The $0.99 and $1.99 packs can each be purchased once per server day. The $4.99 pack can be purchased once during the event.
Activity_desc_AutumnHunt2026_rally: Hunting Whistles and hero supplies. Each pack is available once per event.
Activity_rule_AutumnHunt2026_rally: Groups A and B each offer $0.99, $1.99, $4.99, $9.99, $19.99, $49.99 and $99.99 packs, for 14 packs in total. Switch freely between tiers with no prior purchase required. Each pack can be purchased once during the event.

LC_BP_BattlePass_Desc: Complete Tier Missions to upgrade your Battle Pass Level.
LC_BP_BattlePass_Help:
1. Battle Pass's Zone Missions will be unlocked with Zone News progress.
2. Complete Tier Missions to upgrade your Battle Pass Level and claim corresponding rewards.
3. Unlock the Advanced Battle Pass or Deluxe Battle Pass to get additional rewards, but you can only select one of them to purchase.
4. When the last Zone Mission is available, the Battle Pass will end in a week, and at that time you will not be able to complete Battle Pass missions nor obtain corresponding rewards.
5. You can use Gold to increase your Battle Pass Level, and the amount of Gold needed for each level is fixed.
6. You will not be able to purchase a Battle Pass 30 minutes before it ends. Please make sure to purchase it before this time.

LC_BP_KVK_BattlePass_Desc: Complete Stage Missions in the Biozone to upgrade your Biozone Battle Pass
LC_BP_KVK_BattlePass_Help:
1. As Biozone: Counterattack Progress advances, the Stage Missions for Biozone Battle Pass will gradually be unlocked.
2. Complete Stage Missions in the Biozone to upgrade your Battle Pass Level and claim the corresponding rewards. Each time a new season of Biozone Battle Pass opens, the rewards will be slightly different.
3. Unlocking Advanced Battle Pass or Deluxe Battle Pass will give you additional rewards, but you can only purchase one of them.
4. In contrast to the original Battle Pass event, Biozone Battle Pass lasts the same amount of time as the Biozone event: {0} days. You can do the Battle Pass missions during the first {1} days, and in the remaining time, you can only view or claim rewards.
5. Use Gold to increase your Battle Pass Level, and the amount of Gold required for each level is fixed.
6. You will not be able to purchase a Battle Pass during the final 30 minutes before the Biozone battlefield closes. Please make sure to purchase before this time. 
7. Note: If you use the Zone Transfer feature during the Biozone Battle Pass event, all of your Battle Pass progress will be lost. Please choose carefully!

LC_ALLIANCE_Help_bar_detail:
Each time you receive Guild Help will reduce the total time by 1%. The minimum time reduced by each Guild Help is 1 minute by default. You can increase this number via Guild Research.
You can get limited Individual Exploits daily via Guild Help. After reaching the limit, no Individual Exploits or Guild Exploits can be obtained on that day.
The limit will be reset at 00:00 GMT daily. After resetting, you can continue obtaining Individual Exploits and Guild Exploits via Guild Help.

LC_ALLIANCE_AsBuilding_TerritoryBenefits:
1. Guild Territory can bring additional resource benefits to all Guild members. 
2. Resources can be stored for a maximum of 24 hours once produced. 
3. The larger the Guild Territory, the higher the tax level and the faster the resources are produced.

LC_ALLIANCE_GuildFort_Tips: The Guild Fort is the foundation of all Guild buildings, and once a Fort is built, you can expand your Guild Territory by occupying tiles around it. Territory tiles are effective only when they are linked with a Fort. (You have to build Guild Forts first, then you can build Guild Towers to expand your territory.)

LC_ALLIANCE_GuildFort2_Tips: Guild Fort 2 is a territory building. When the No.3 Separation Barrier is removed, Guild Fort 2 can be built as a new starting point for Guild Development.

LC_ALLIANCE_GuildTower_Tips: Guild Towers can expand your territory, but they have to be built on tiles linked with effective Guild Territory.

LC_ALLIANCE_AsBuilding_Territory_TitleTo:
1. Build Guild Forts and Towers to expand your Guild Territory, obtain Territory Revenue, and upgrade your tax level according to your Territory level.
2. Higher Guild Territory levels mean more Territory Revenue.
3. When the Guild is not in control of a territory tile, it will lose the corresponding Territory Revenue.
4. Territory tiles linked with Guild Forts are valid territory. Otherwise, it's invalid and won't provide any Territory Revenue.
5. Other Guild Buildings or Cities linked with valid territory tiles can be attacked.

LC_ALLIANCE_Individual_Exploit_tips:
Individual Exploits
1. You can get Individual Exploits via Guild Help, Guild Research Donations, Guild Construction, and by opening Guild Gifts.
2. Individual Exploits can be used to buy items in the Guild Store.
3. After you get Individual Exploits, you will earn the same amount of Guild Exploits for your Guild.
LC_ALLIANCE_Guild_Exploit_tips:
Guild Exploits
1. After Guild members get Individual Exploits via Guild Help, Guild Research Donations, and Guild Construction, they will earn the same amount of Guild Exploits for the Guild.
2. Guild Exploits can be used in Guild Construction and Research.

LC_ALLIANCE_Storehouse_tips:
1. Guild Exploits can be obtained via Guild Help, Guild Research Donations, and Guild Construction.
2. After occupying tiles, a Guild can obtain Territory Revenue and increase its tax level. The more Territory Revenue, the higher the tax level and the more Guild Cash that can be obtained.
3. You can increase your Guild Storehouse Capacity via Guild Research.
LC_ALLIANCE_Guild_Gift_Tips:
1. When any Guild member purchases a pack or destroys a Cyclops, all members will get a Guild Gift.
2. Guild Gifts contain reward items, Chest Points, and Favorability.
3. Chest Points are used to increase the Gift Level, and Favorability is used to get the General's Reward.
4. When a General's Favorability is full, all Guild members will get a General's Reward. Tap to get generous rewards!
5. Different Generals will appear for every 10 Guild Gift levels. A higher-level General will grant a better General's Reward.
LC_ALLIANCE_Favorability_Tips:
General's Reward 
1. Open a Guild Gift to increase a General's Favorability. 
2. When a General's Favorability is full, you can open a General's Reward. 
3. A different General will appear for every 10 levels, and Generals at higher levels indicate a better General's Reward. 
4. You can get lots of items after opening a General's Reward.

LC_ALLIANCE_GVG_Rule_Backstory_Text: In order to better resist the evil Dead Empire and its Zombie Legion, the Supreme Allied Command organized a military exercise to test the combat ability of various Guilds. They called the exercise "Mars Challenge" in honor of the god of war.
LC_ALLIANCE_GVG_Rule_PlayRule_Text:
The two guilds successfully matched up by the system will enter a brand-new map to battle. The first complete occupation (occupation for a period of time until the color of the building changes to the color of its own force) or continuous occupation of the building, could both earn you guild points and personal points. 
 You can earn a lot of points if you escort Mars War Flag to the right destination. 

 After a fierce battle, the party with a higher overall guild points will eventually win the competition. Many amazing rewards will be issued based on the battle's result and personal points.
LC_ALLIANCE_GVG_Rule_Flow_Text:
1. Signing up
 Guilds with their overall Combat Power ranked in the top 20 of the server can be signed up by the leader and his officials. Players who joined the guild after the signup will not be selected as participants, nor will they be able to get the rewards for Mars Challenge. After the signup deadline, the list of participants will be locked and cannot be changed. 
 2. Personnel Management
 Guild leaders and their officials can select up to 20 main forces and 10 substitutes to participate in the battle on the personnel management page. 
 3. Entering the battlefield
 When Mars Challenge is initiated, players will enter a brand-new map. Before entering the battlefield, please make sure there are no queue dispatches, no damaged troops in repair shops and the troops are not in a War Fever state. 
 4. The battle begins
 After entering the battlefield, the blue party's initial base is at the top left of the map, while the red party's initial base is at the bottom right of the map. 
 Preparation Phase: You cannot use city relocation items, nor to occupy buildings or send out troops. You can use guild markers though. 
 Battle Phase:
 Phase 1: Field Airports and Frontline Sentry Posts will be open. 
 Phase 2: Other Buildings will be open. 
 Phase 3: The Hall of Mars will be open, then Mars War Flag will appear, and the battle begins in an all-round way. 
 
 End phase: Enter the results interface, and the party with a higher overall guild score will win.
LC_ALLIANCE_GVG_Rule_Building_Museum_Tex:
In the center of the arena, the Hall of Mars stores Mars War Flags. After a War Flag appears at the Hall of Mars, both parties can begin to compete for it. The Guild that eventually escorts a War Flag to their owned building will receive a large number of points.￼
After a successful escort, the War Flag will reappear in the Hall of Mars after a while. The points earned for a successful escort will increase continually. If you visit the Supply Depot before escorting the War Flag, the War Flag will drop in its place.
LC_ALLIANCE_GVG_Rule_Building_Garage_Tex: The factory used to repair vehicles and weapons. After occupying this place, the repair speed of the damaged units in the repair shop of all the combatants of the guild will be increased.
LC_ALLIANCE_GVG_Rule_Building_Arsenal_Te: A factory that produces weapons and ammunition, the core of Combat Power guarantee. Once occupied, the offensive and defensive power of all the guild combatants will be increased.
LC_ALLIANCE_GVG_Rule_Building_Playerbase: Temporary headquarters have been set up in the arena by the red and blue parties. Answer the challenge of Mars, the god of war, and fight for glory!
LC_ALLIANCE_GVG_Rule_Building_Fortress_T: In war, heavy bunkers possess unique combat powers. They can not only be used to defend key locations, but also act as new bases to attack the enemy. At any time, having heavy bunkers are necessary for carrying out the next step of planning. After occupying this place, you can earn a lot of points.
LC_ALLIANCE_GVG_Rule_Building_Airport_Te: The field airbase is the most important strategic location at the beginning of the battle. After the occupation, the field command can be transferred by combatants to the area where the field airport is located. The first occupation of the Field Airport will increase the number of guild city relocation by 5 times, and the second occupation will increase it by 2 times. After the continuous occupation of the field airport, the number of guild city relocation will be restored at regular intervals.
LC_ALLIANCE_GVG_Rule_Building_Depot_Text: The supply station stores all kinds of supplies needed for the battle. Visiting here in the battlefield will earn you some guild and personal points. However, players need to return to the field base to get the final points. The supply stations will be refreshed a total of three times, and the unvisited ones will remain on the battlefield.
LC_ALLIANCE_GVG_Rule_Building_Sentry_Tex: Located on the periphery of the complex, used as a guard post, you can spot the enemy's movements at any time from here. A small number of points can be earned after occupation.

LC_ALLIANCE_GVG_Rule_Others_Battle_Text:
In Mars Challenge, the basic rules of battle are the same as before. 
All participants are able to March freely in the battlefield in Mars Challenge. 
Occupy various buildings in the battlefield to earn guild and personal points. Some buildings (repair shops, armories) will also bring different buffs. 
Killing enemy forces when defending buildings and fighting in the field earns you personal points. You will earn40personal points for killing every 10000 worth of Combat Power of enemies. However, you will not earn any guild points; When attacking buildings, you will earn 80 personal points for killing every 10000 worth of Combat Power of enemies. However, you will not earn any guild points. 
You will earn a large number of points after successfully escorting Mars War Flag back to a non-enemy building. In addition, as Mars War Flag refreshes each time, the points they carry will increase. Please note that you only have 15 minutes to escort Mars War Flag. Mars War Flag will disappear at the end of the time and will refresh again in 3 minutes. 
The number of city relocations shared by the guild combatants is capped at 20 times. The first occupation of the field airport will increase the number of city relocations by 5 times, and the second occupation will increase it by 2 times. After the continuous occupation, a certain number of city relocations will be restored at regular intervals. 
In Mars Challenge, the fighting units will not die. They only get damaged and then enter the repair shop. In the battlefield, there is no upper limit for the capacity of the repair shop, and there is no resource consumption for healing wounded units. Wounded units in the hospital will automatically recover when you leave the battlefield. 
If you fail to defend the field command, the burning speed will be greatly increased. If the fire is not put out in time, it may lead to forced withdrawal to the safe area. 
If you leave the field midway through, the player's personal points will be cleared and the player will not be able to re-enter the field until after 15 minutes. 
The buffs of guild technology, guild title, personal technology, officer's talent, VIP, national characteristics, inner-city buildings, special themes and some items will continue to work in Mars Challenge.
Buffs for Goverment titles, cities and war zone will not take effect in Mars Challenge.
LC_ALLIANCE_GVG_Rule_Others_Tips_Text:
1. If you have troops stationed in the building, you can still move the field command to the vicinity of the airport (not applicable when collecting from the supply station). 
 2. You can give orders to your troops by selecting and dragging the officer's profile picture on the troop list on the right-hand side. 
 3. Mars War Flag cannot be transported to the safe area. If they enter the safe area, they will reappear in the Hall of Mars immediately. 
 4. In Mars Challenge, tap the button at the bottom of the screen to see the score of your guild or exit the battlefield. 
 5. In Mars Challenge, only one player can station troops in a building. Therefore, when escorting Mars War Flag, make sure that there are no units of your own in the target building (except for the field command).
LC_ALLIANCE_GVG_Rule_Others_Limit_Text:
Some of the game's functions will be limited during Mars Challenge. 
 1. During the opening of the battlefield, all personnel management operations of the guild will be temporarily disabled. 
 2. After entering the battlefield, players will temporarily not be able to provide aids to the guild members in the original server or offer guild help. 
 3. After entering the battlefield, players will not be able to carry out any troop dispatch operations outside Mars Challenge. 
 4. Each player can only send one scout group to the battlefield.

1. The Recruitment Wall is shared by the entire world. Guilds can bid for their place on the Recruitment Wall. The one who pays more will get seats in the front row.

4. If a Guild withdraws its bid, the unused Guild Coins will be returned to the Guild.

LC_ALLIANCE_AsSkill_10_D: Instantly places a temporary Guild Fort on the map. The Fort does not require any construction.
LC_ALLIANCE_AsSkill_10_tipsdetail:
1. After the skill is used, a temporary Guild Fort is immediately placed on the map. This Temporary Fort does not require any construction, and can be placed on any empty 3x3 square of territory that your troops can access. The Fort only lasts for a certain duration.
2. For its duration, the Temporary Fort will provide valid Guild Territory. This territory will not be calculated in your Territory Tiles, Territory Taxes, or Territory Wages, but it will provide all other Territory Revenue. Guild members can also use Territory Teleport items on this territory.
3. All players who do not belong to your Guild may attack the Temporary Fort without fulfilling any preconditions.
4. The Temporary Fort will be demolished when its duration expires. It can also be manually demolished or burned down. Temporary Fort fires cannot be put out.
5. "Temporary Durability" and "Territory Slowdown" skills will not take effect against Temporary Forts and the temporary territories they produce. Other Guild building buffs will also not take effect for Temporary Forts.
LC_ALLIANCE_AsSkill_page_des: Make Donations to use Guild Skills that are powerful enough to turn the tide of battle!
LC_ALLIANCE_AsSkill_recharge_tips:
How Charging Works
1. Guild members can use Donations to increase the Charging progress.
2. Once the Charging progress is full, the Guild Leader or Officials can use Guild Skills.
3. Charging Donations and Research Donations use the same Donation Chances. Similarly, both of these will be calculated into the Daily Donation progress.
4. You can continue to charge while skills are in cooldown, but you must wait until the cooldown is finished before the skills can be used again.

LC_ASSIGNMENT_Comm_Games_Poker_Desc: It costs 1 card to play a game with an Officer. Cards are replenished daily based on your HQ level.
LC_ASSIGNMENT_Assign_Rules:
Appoint Officers to different jobs to increase your base efficiency.
Only one Officer can be appointed to each task.
An Officer's effectiveness depends on their Trust in you—Officers with a higher level of Trust are more effective.
Orange Officers have higher work efficiency, so give them priority in your training.
LC_ASSIGNMENT_Comm_Rules:
Here, you can interact with your Officers.
Tap different parts of an Officer's body to see how they respond.
Increase the Officer's Trust in you by giving gifts, tapping them, and playing games with them.
There's a daily limit on how many times you can increase Trust by tapping them. After reaching that limit, give them gifts to increase their Trust!
LC_ASSIGNMENT_Comm_Games_Rules:
Playing games with Officers will also increase their Trust.
Trust will be increased regardless of whether you win or lose, but the number of games you can play depends on the number of cards you have.
Cards are replenished daily, and the max number of cards you can have every day is based on your HQ level.
LC_ASSIGNMENT_Comm_Games_Full: Trust Level for this Officer is full. Continuing playing games won't increase Trust any further. Continue?
LC_ASSIGNMENT_Comm_Games_Leave: If you leave now, you will lose this game chance. Continue?
LC_ASSIGNMENT_Comm_Trust_Full: You must upgrade your Trust Level to continue.
LC_ASSIGNMENT_Comm_Trust_Overflow: Giving this gift will cause Trust to overflow, and after upgrading your Trust Level, the overflowed amount will be lost. Continue?

LC_ASSIGNMENT_Comm_Talia_Head_High_2: Call me a devil—at least you’re still alive.
LC_ASSIGNMENT_Comm_Talia_Head_High_3: Every time you fall asleep, I check on you. You just don’t know it.
LC_ASSIGNMENT_Comm_Talia_Hand_High_1: Just live. Don’t ask what’s in the syringe.
LC_ASSIGNMENT_Comm_Talia_Hand_High_2: If you want to live, shut up and take the treatment.
LC_ASSIGNMENT_Comm_Talia_Hand_High_3: Your breathing’s off—is it the pain, or is it me?
LC_ASSIGNMENT_Comm_Talia_Body_High_1: Muscle is rebuilding… flawless work of art…
LC_ASSIGNMENT_Comm_Talia_Body_High_3: Your reflexes are… more fascinating than I expected.
LC_ASSIGNMENT_Comm_Talia_Greet_1: Evelyn is too naive. The battlefield is cruel.
LC_ASSIGNMENT_Comm_Talia_Greet_2: Northern wind and snow bury too many secrets.
LC_ASSIGNMENT_Comm_Talia_Greet_3: I will never abandon a comrade’s life!
LC_ASSIGNMENT_Comm_Talia_Refuse_1: If you’re not hurt, stay away from me. Scalpels don’t miss on purpose.
LC_ASSIGNMENT_Comm_Talia_Refuse_2: Touch me again and I’ll pickle you in formalin.
LC_ASSIGNMENT_Comm_Talia_Refuse_3: Hold still. I’m watching your nerve response.
LC_ASSIGNMENT_Comm_Talia_Game_Lose: Relax. Maybe you’ll turn it around next round.
LC_ASSIGNMENT_Comm_Talia_Wait: Move it—there are more wounded outside!
LC_ASSIGNMENT_Comm_Romana_Head_Low_1: Your eyes look thirsty. You need something stronger.
LC_ASSIGNMENT_Comm_Romana_Head_Low_2: Don’t comfort me. Liquor’s more honest than people.
LC_ASSIGNMENT_Comm_Romana_Head_Low_3: He said he’d come back. Soldiers don’t break promises.
LC_ASSIGNMENT_Comm_Romana_Hand_Low_1: This one’s on me—to those who never made it home.
LC_ASSIGNMENT_Comm_Romana_Hand_Low_2: Have a shot. It helps drown out the smell of gunpowder.
LC_ASSIGNMENT_Comm_Romana_Hand_Low_3: Rome without him is just rubble.
LC_ASSIGNMENT_Comm_Romana_Body_Low_1: Anyone who drinks alone has a story.
LC_ASSIGNMENT_Comm_Romana_Body_Low_2: Keep your tip. I’d rather hear intel.
LC_ASSIGNMENT_Comm_Romana_Body_Low_3: Try this—it's strong enough to put you out till morning.
LC_ASSIGNMENT_Comm_Romana_Head_High_1: There’s no fine wine in wartime. Make do.
LC_ASSIGNMENT_Comm_Romana_Head_High_2: Don’t take that seat. It’s taken.
LC_ASSIGNMENT_Comm_Romana_Head_High_3: You look like him. But you’re not him.
LC_ASSIGNMENT_Comm_Romana_Hand_High_1: Drinking that much—waiting for someone, or trying to forget someone?
LC_ASSIGNMENT_Comm_Romana_Hand_High_2: Slow down. No one’s stealing your drink.
LC_ASSIGNMENT_Comm_Romana_Hand_High_3: When he’s back, we’ll have the wedding.
LC_ASSIGNMENT_Comm_Romana_Body_High_1: All lies melt in strong liquor.
LC_ASSIGNMENT_Comm_Romana_Body_High_2: Another round? I’ll drink with you. I’m waiting too.
LC_ASSIGNMENT_Comm_Romana_Body_High_3: A glimmer on the Tiber—aged three years in patience.
LC_ASSIGNMENT_Comm_Romana_Greet_1: New face? Which front did you crawl in from?
LC_ASSIGNMENT_Comm_Romana_Greet_2: House rules: pay up, drink, and don’t start trouble.
LC_ASSIGNMENT_Comm_Romana_Refuse_1: Hands off, soldier. You're crossing the line.
LC_ASSIGNMENT_Comm_Romana_Refuse_2: Stop staring at my neckline. Stare at your glass.
LC_ASSIGNMENT_Comm_Romana_Refuse_3: Don’t stand so close. I don’t like strangers’ scent.
LC_ASSIGNMENT_Comm_Romana_Game_Lose: It’s just one loss. Don’t sulk.
LC_ASSIGNMENT_Comm_Romana_Game_Start: Play a hand. The night’s still young.
LC_ASSIGNMENT_Comm_Romana_Wait: No one walks away from this war unscarred.
LC_ASSIGNMENT_Comm_Barbara_Head_Low_1: Want to work with me? Show me you're serious first.
LC_ASSIGNMENT_Comm_Barbara_Head_Low_2: My firepower clears your path, anytime.
LC_ASSIGNMENT_Comm_Barbara_Head_Low_3: Looks like... someone's in for a bad night...
LC_ASSIGNMENT_Comm_Barbara_Hand_Low_1: I don't raise hothouse flowers here!
LC_ASSIGNMENT_Comm_Barbara_Hand_Low_2: Surviving these dark times was never about a soft heart.
LC_ASSIGNMENT_Comm_Barbara_Hand_Low_3: Money's ready... and so am I...
LC_ASSIGNMENT_Comm_Barbara_Body_Low_1: These iron fists can tear through anything in my way!
LC_ASSIGNMENT_Comm_Barbara_Body_Low_2: Right price, and I'll take any job, no matter how messy.
LC_ASSIGNMENT_Comm_Barbara_Head_High_2: A mercenary doesn't pick sides, just jobs worth taking.
LC_ASSIGNMENT_Comm_Barbara_Head_High_3: Sure it's only business you want with me?
LC_ASSIGNMENT_Comm_Barbara_Hand_High_1: No prisoner to the machine, only a free fighter!
LC_ASSIGNMENT_Comm_Barbara_Hand_High_2: Skip the pleasantries. On the battlefield, weapons do the talking.
LC_ASSIGNMENT_Comm_Barbara_Body_High_1: A pretty face is useless, strength is what counts.
LC_ASSIGNMENT_Comm_Barbara_Body_High_2: Veterans never die, they just live another way.
LC_ASSIGNMENT_Comm_Barbara_Body_High_3: There's something dishonest in your eyes.
LC_ASSIGNMENT_Comm_Barbara_Greet_1: Sometimes flesh is harder than steel!
LC_ASSIGNMENT_Comm_Barbara_Greet_3: A mercenary takes only cash and lives.
LC_ASSIGNMENT_Comm_Barbara_Refuse_2: I'll settle the score with all that greed!
LC_ASSIGNMENT_Comm_Barbara_Refuse_3: Going easy isn't really my thing...
LC_ASSIGNMENT_Comm_Barbara_Game_Win: You're cheating. I can feel it.
LC_ASSIGNMENT_Comm_Barbara_Game_Lose: Want a comeback? One more round!
LC_ASSIGNMENT_Comm_Barbara_Wait: I charge by the hour, you know.
LC_ASSIGNMENT_Comm_Roisin_Head_Low_1: Think you can chew through hard bread?
LC_ASSIGNMENT_Comm_Roisin_Body_Low_1: Come help me spread the butter.
LC_ASSIGNMENT_Comm_Roisin_Head_High_1: Don't touch! Go wash your hands first!
LC_ASSIGNMENT_Comm_Roisin_Head_High_2: You're so hungry your eyes are glazing over.
LC_ASSIGNMENT_Comm_Roisin_Hand_High_1: Let me open a fine bottle for you!
LC_ASSIGNMENT_Comm_Roisin_Hand_High_2: Authentic Irish cream, rich and smooth.
LC_ASSIGNMENT_Comm_Roisin_Body_High_2: Help me wipe off this sweat.
LC_ASSIGNMENT_Comm_Roisin_Greet_2: Do you like it sweet or spicy?
LC_ASSIGNMENT_Comm_Roisin_Refuse_1: Get out! Don't mess up my kitchen!
LC_ASSIGNMENT_Comm_Roisin_Refuse_3: My cake knife is plenty sharp.
LC_ASSIGNMENT_Comm_Roisin_Game_Lose: Don't lose heart—you'll win next time!
LC_ASSIGNMENT_Comm_Roisin_Wait: Hurry, the bread's about to burn!

LC_BUILD_b2_build_info_armory_tank: The Tank Armory produces Tanks, which are the most effective unit in war. Upgrade the Tank Armory to increase its production capacity.
LC_BUILD_b2_build_info_armory_apc: The Drill Grounds trains Infantry so they can maneuver flexibly on the battlefield. Upgrade the Drill Grounds to increase its production capacity.
LC_BUILD_b2_build_info_armory_atgun: The Tank Destroyer Armory produces Tank Destroyers, which deal lots of damage to Tanks, but are weak versus Infantry. Upgrade the Tank Destroyer Armory to increase its production capacity.
LC_BUILD_b2_build_info_armory_rocket: The Artillery Armory produces Artillery, which are adept at gathering resources but only mediocre in battle. Upgrade the Artillery Armory to increase its production capacity.
LC_BUILD_b2_garage_hurt_units_rule:
Please note the following regarding the Garage and damaged units:
1. When attacking NPC units, only a small amount of your units will be seriously damaged. These units will return to the Garage.
2. When attacking the base or Guild buildings of another player, none of the seriously damaged units will return to the Garage.
3. When garrisoned at Guild buildings, 50% of seriously damaged units will return to the Garage.
4. When attacking unoccupied Cities, all seriously damaged units will return to the Garage.
5. When battling in Lv.1 and Lv.2 Cities, all seriously damaged units will return to the Garage.
6. When battling in Lv.3 Cities, 50% of seriously damaged units will return to the Garage.
7. When battling in the Government, no seriously damaged units will return to the Garage.
8. If the maximum Garage Capacity is reached, no seriously damaged units will be able to return to the Garage.
9. Seriously damaged units that cannot return to the Garage will be scrapped immediately. They are calculated as losses and can no longer be used.

LC_BUILD_defense_center_tips1:
1. You can choose Officers to garrison at the Defense Center. When your base is under attack, your Garrison Officers will lead your troops to resist the enemy and protect your base.
2. The boosts from your Garrison Officers can be stacked with your base's own boosts.
3. When you haven't appointed any Garrison Officers, or when your Garrison Officers are off-base, the most powerful Officers on your base will automatically be appointed as temporary Garrison Officers until you replace them or the previously-appointed Garrison Officers return.
4. Backup Garrison Officer Mechanism: The Defense Center will add a backup Garrison Officer. When the Garrison Officer is dispatched, the backup Garrison Officer will take over the Defense Center, reinforcing according to the order of avatars. When the Garrison Officer returns, they will automatically regain control of the Defense Center. If the garrison configuration is changed and saved during this period, the latest Garrison Officer settings will be used for reinforcement.
LC_BUILD_defense_center_tips2:
1. Your base will start burning when all of your garrison troops are defeated, and it will burn for 30 minutes. During this time, your Base Defense will decrease continuously.
2. When Base Defense reaches zero, your base will be teleported to a random location.

LC_BUILD_Military_School_Title4: It allows XP to be transferred to a new commander.

LC_BUILD_new_DM_info_text:
1. You need to bind your Diamond Mine to a Facebook/Wechat account. Each Facebook/Wechat account can only be bound to one Diamond Mine. 
2. After binding, a Diamond Mine will be unlocked and its functions will be available for players. 
3. After your Facebook friends have bound their Diamond Mine, you and your friends can gift each other! Please note, the gifts are provided by the system for free. Each friend can only give you 1 gift per day. The more friends you have, the more gifts you can get each day. Gifts received can be claimed in the Rewards Center. (This function is not available for Wechat accounts for now.) 
4. You can unbind your Diamond Mine. After unbinding your Diamond Mine, you can use this Facebook/Wechat account to bind another Diamond Mine. The current mine will become ‘Locked’ again.

LC_COMMON_b2_expedition_rules:
1. In the Campaign, you can complete a series of military maneuvers in order. After completing a maneuver, you can then challenge the next one.
2. After completing a maneuver, you can get a 1-3 Star rating and obtain corresponding rewards. 
3. There are no chance limits for maneuver challenges. But you can claim each reward only once daily. 
4. There are no actual unit losses during maneuver challenges. 
5. Maneuver Rewards will be refreshed at 00:00 UTC daily. 
6. You can directly claim rewards of a 3-Star maneuver. For non-3-Star maneuvers, you have to challenge again to claim the rewards. 
7. Tap the [Claim] button to claim rewards from all 3-Star maneuvers. 
8. All boosts are in effect in the Campaign. 
9. Officers won't gain XP from maneuver challenges.
LC_COMMON_b2_expedition_mission_hint: Set your troops at the bottom.
LC_COMMON_b2_expedition_troops_rules:
1. Available units you can deploy in the Campaign are determined by your Armory production and promotions. 
2. Units you obtain through other means can't be deployed in the Campaign. 
3. Unit losses in a maneuver won't affect your available units for the next maneuver. 
4. Your actual units won't be reduced either. Just go for it.

LC_COMMON_Unit_tips_infantry_US_T1: Early US Infantry Squad, equipped with M1 Garands.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_infantry_US_T2: US Infantry Squad equipped with Thompson submachine guns, excels at close range combat.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_infantry_US_T3: US Airborne Squad equipped with M3 scout cars, demonstrates strong mobility.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_infantry_US_T4: US Ranger Squad equipped with M20 light armored cars, guaranteed mobility, and further strengthened by firepower.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_infantry_US_T5: US Special Ops Commandos equipped with M8 armored cars, great attackers and highly mobile.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_tank_US_T1: The M22 Locust, the first airborne light tank designed by the US, provides great firepower, mobility, and cover for airborne operations. The tank is also an important reference for the rest of the world for developing airborne-capable tanks.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_tank_US_T2: The M3 Lee was primarily deployed by the British Forces in the North African Campaign. Due to its design flaws, it was withdrawn from combat as soon as the M4 Sherman tank became available. A total of 6,258 M3 Lees were produced in history.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_tank_US_T3: The most famous tank during WWII, the M4A3E8 was one of its primary models in the later periods.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_tank_US_T4: The US Army's most powerful heavy tank in late WWII and best known for its balanced firepower, armor, and mobility.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_tank_US_T5: Experimental heavy tank in development since 1944, featuring 105mm T5E1 guns with heavy firepower. However, only a small number of prototypes were produced in 1947.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_TD_US_T1: This tank destroyer was developed based on the M3 tank in 1942. The vehicle never entered mass production.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_TD_US_T2: The tank destroyer used by the US Army during WWII that came with a mounted 76.2 mm gun, nicknamed the Wolverine.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_TD_US_T3: The quickest vehicle of all the tracked AFVs for the US Army during WWII, nicknamed the Hellcat.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_TD_US_T4: Developed based on the T23 medium tank, but never entered mass production.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_TD_US_T5: Designed for the US Army to break through German defenses with its mounted 105mm gun and thick armor that was up to 305 mm thick in the front.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_artillery_US_T1: Weighing in at only 653 kg, it can be disassembled into 9 pieces for airdrops, or 8 pieces to be transported by horse and buggy. It is especially suitable for long distances and complex terrain.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_artillery_US_T2: The howitzer developed and mass-produced by the US during WWII, suitable for light troops. During WWII, it was primarily utilized by US airborne forces.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_artillery_US_T3: The 155mm towed howitzer was adopted by the US Army in 1942, with a maximum firing range of 14.6km and able to fire multiple regular projectiles and nuclear bombs.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_artillery_US_T4: The original turrets placed atop the M4 Sherman were replaced by the T34E2, a multiple rocket launcher that fires a barrage of 183 mm rockets from multiple launch tubes.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_artillery_US_T5: The M115 203 mm howitzer, with a maximum range of 16.8 km.

LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_infantry_CCCP_T1: Early Soviet infantry equipped with Mosin-Nagants as their primary weapons.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_infantry_CCCP_T2: In order to enhance the firepower of each soldier, the Soviet infantry started to use the PPSh-41 submachine gun, giving a stronger presence when battling in urban environments.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_infantry_CCCP_T3: Scout squads that are equipped with BA-64 armored cars possess both mobility and firepower.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_infantry_CCCP_T4: Guard squads that participated in the Battle of Moscow possessed a strong will and proficient combat skills.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_infantry_CCCP_T5: Soviet special assault troops equipped with BTR-40 armored cars. Each of them is a skilled combatant.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_tank_CCCP_T1: The T70 was a light tank used by the Soviet Red Army during WWII. It was used to replace the T-60 and T-50 in scouting and infantry support functions.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_tank_CCCP_T2: The T28 was one of the first medium tanks to serve in the Red Army. It served the Soviet army from 1933 to 1944, and during that time, the campaigns it primarily participated in were the Winter War and on the Eastern Front.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_tank_CCCP_T3: The T34-85 is famous tank that was upgraded from a T-34 medium tank by the Soviets in 1943. It possessed good firepower, defense, and mobility. It was also reliable and easy to produce due to its simple design.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_tank_CCCP_T4: The KV2 was the second type of heavy tank KV series the Soviets produced during WWII, and it was classified as self-propelled artillery. Equipped with a 152 mm gun, the KV2 possessed extremely ferocious firepower, and it was called the Russian Colossus by the Germans due to its huge hull.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_tank_CCCP_T5: The IS-3 was a Soviet heavy tank developed during WWII, and it first appeared in the Berlin Victory Parade of 1945. The IS-3 started to be mass-produced just a few days before the war was over, so it was too late for it to participate in any combat.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_TD_CCCP_T1: The SU-76M is a light tank destroyer produced by the Soviets during WWII.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_TD_CCCP_T2: The SU-85B is equipped with a better engine and an 85 mm LB-2 gun with a muzzle brake, thus the stability issue that occurred with the SU-76M was not present. It's larger tank hull greatly increased its fire rate to 10 rounds per minute.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_TD_CCCP_T3: In 1944, with heavy tanks like the Tiger and Panther classes deployed to the battlefield, the Soviet SU-85 tank destroyers couldn't penetrate their thick armor at a safe range, and the SU-85's firepower was nothing like the T-34/85, so the Soviet forces began to develop the SU-100 to replace the SU-85.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_TD_CCCP_T4: The ISU-152 is a heavy tank destroyer developed and used by Soviet forces during WWII. It used the chassis and hull from the IS-2 heavy tank, and was equipped with a 152 mm ML-20 gun.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_TD_CCCP_T5: The Object 268 is a heavy tank destroyer designed to confront western tanks after the war concluded. It was developed by the Motovilikha Plant, but due to its less-than-ideal performance in actual combat, it never saw mass-production.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_artillery_CCCP_T1: The OB-25 is a Soviet infantry support gun developed by the Motovilikha Plant. The gun used a 76 caliber and was light and easy to use. However, it wasn't successful enough. Due to its low muzzle velocity, it was unable to use high explosive shells and unable to deal with armored targets. The gun's production ceased in the late period of WWII.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_artillery_CCCP_T2: Designed by F. F. Petrov, the M-30 howitzer uses a 122 mm barrel, and it was the Soviet's main artillery unit in WWII.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_artillery_CCCP_T3: The ML-20 152 mm howitzer is a heavy artillery piece that was used by Soviet forces in WWII. Designed and produced by the Motovilikha Plant, the ML-20 served the Soviet forces from 1937 to 1946. During WWII, the ML-20 was mainly used as Soviet fire support.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_artillery_CCCP_T4: The Katyusha rocket launcher was the rocket artillery first built and fielded by Soviet forces in WWII. Compared with other artillery, these mutli-rocket launchers could fire a barrage of missiles to targets very quickly, but they lacked accuracy and took longer to reload. Although they were more vulnerable than other artillery, they were easy to produce and cost less.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_artillery_CCCP_T5: The BR-5 was a piece of heavy artillery that used a 280 mm cannon. It could fire many kinds of shells, including armor-piercing shells that could penetrate concrete. The shells' warheads weighed over 200 kilos, with some shells even reaching 286 kilos. Each shell could create a crater with a radius of 10 meters and depth of 6 meters. The artillery's effective range was 10 kilometers.

LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_infantry_GE_T1: A German infantry squad equipped with a Kar98k. They are the basic combat units of the German army.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_infantry_GE_T2: The squad's firepower was remarkably boosted after being equipped with MP40 automatic submachine guns.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_infantry_GE_T3: As the German army's elite troops, they inherited the name Grenadier because of their excellent combat skills and strong will.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_infantry_GE_T4: After being equipped with the Sd.Kfz. 222, MP40 squads' firepower, mobility, and protection were greatly increased, giving them an advantage in urban and field battles.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_infantry_GE_T5: Special squads equipped with the earliest assault rifle StG 44. All soldiers come from the airborne forces. Operating with Sd.Kfz. 234 armored vehicles, they can launch strikes on any targets.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_tank_GE_T1: Tanks that were obtained after the Germans occupied Czechoslovakia. Their prototype was the LT-38 light tank and was the most successful product of Czechoslovakian industry. They were produced based on design practicalities from LT-35 tanks.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_tank_GE_T2: In order to cope with the League of Nations, this vehicle was originally called ZW. Widely used in WWII by the Germans, the Panzer III had many derivatives and advanced versions, which served the German army until the end of WWII.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_tank_GE_T3: The Panzer IV was originally designed to support infantry and work with the Panzer III, which was specialized in dealing with anti-tank missions. When the overall performance of the Panzer III didn't meet the requirements in the middle parts of WWII, the Panzer IV gradually became the primary combat unit of the armor divisions due to its more mature technology and more room for upgrades.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_tank_GE_T4: The Tiger I served the German army from late 1942 until 1945 when Germany surrendered. Tiger I tanks were widely deployed on the front lines, and they destroyed many enemy tanks and artillery pieces during the war, making them dangerous foes for all allied tanks. The allied tanks that could destroy or damage Tiger I tanks were called Tiger Tamers.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_tank_GE_T5: The Tiger II was the next generation of the Tiger I. They inherited the heavy armor from Tiger I tanks, along with the sloped armor from Panther tanks. A Tiger II tank weighed 70 tonnes. It was equipped with 100-180 mm front armor and an 8.8 cm KwK 43 gun. The Tiger II shared the chassis from the Jagdpanther, which didn't have a turret.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_TD_GE_T1: The Marder II was a tank destroyer used by the German army during WWII. It used the chassis of the Panzer II, and was equipped with a 7.62 cm Pak 36(r) or 7.5 cm Pak 40 (Germany) anti-tank gun.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_TD_GE_T2: The StuG III was the most produced armored vehicle used by the German army during WWII, and it used the chassis of the Panzer III. It was originally designed to support infantry, but after a series of improvements, it finally possessed an anti-tank function in 1942. A total of 10.500 StuG IIIs were produced until the end of the war.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_TD_GE_T3: The Jagdpanther used the chassis of the Panther tank. It retained the engine and armor of the original vehicle, adding a new turret structure. It was equipped with an 8.8 cm Pak 43 anti-tank gun. A total of 384 were produced until March 1945.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_TD_GE_T4: It was the tank destroyer used by the Wehrmacht in WWII, and its ordnance inventory designation was Sd.Kfz. 184. Its original names were Sturmgeschütz mit 8.8cm Pak43/2 and Panzerjäger Tiger (P). It was dubbed Ferdinand in a meeting in 1943, and then renamed Elefant on Feb 27th, 1944.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_TD_GE_T5: The Jagdtiger was a heavy tank destroyer used by the German army during WWII. It shared the same chassis from the Tiger II tank, and it served Germany from late 1944 until the end of the war. The Jagdtiger was deployed in both the Eastern Front and the Western Front. It's the heaviest armored vehicle that was put into use during WWII, and also the heaviest armor vehicle that officially entered mass production.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_artillery_GE_T1: The Krupp 7.5 cm Model 1903 was first used in WWI, and then served the German army until WWII. The German army developed the Krupp 7.5 cm Model 1903 based on the design of the7.5 cm FK 16 nA.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_artillery_GE_T2: As the replacement for the 10.5 cm leFH 16, the 10.5 cm leFH 18 was the most important piece of artillery for the German army during WWII. It was first officially produced in 1929 and served the German army throughout WWII as the standard artillery for the Wehrmacht.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_artillery_GE_T3: The main heavy artillery used by the German army during WWII. Each infantry division was equipped with 12 for support. Although the actual caliber was only 149.1 mm, it still followed the nomenclature of its predecessor, 15 cm sFH 13.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_artillery_GE_T4: In 1942, the German army started to develop 150 mm self-propelled artillery. The chassis they chose was from the Sdkfz.4/1 “mule” armored vehicle. The back of the vehicle transformed into a turret, with 10 rocket launchers mounted on top.
LC_COMMON_Unit_Tips_artillery_GE_T5: The 21 cm Mörser 18 was designed to replace the 21 cm Mörser 16, which was used in WWI. It had a caliber of 211 mm, and It was one of the first artillery pieces that incorporated a dual-recoil system.

LC_COMMON_arena_rule_text:
Introduction
1. In the Normandy Arena, you can challenge other Commanders to obtain points and rewards.
2. The first {0} challenge chance(s) will be free in the Normandy Arena every day. Each challenge will cost one Challenge Ticket after you have used up your free chances. Challenge Tickets can be obtained by completing daily missions. Challenge Tickets can be accumulated, but the number will be reset at the end of each Season.
3. After winning a battle, you can obtain certain points. However, losing a battle will lose you points. You can claim rewards for your corresponding rankings every day.
4. Each Season in the Arena consists of 7 days. When one Season ends, you can claim Season Rewards for your corresponding rankings. In the meantime, all Commanders' points will be reset.
5. At the beginning of a new Season, all Commanders have to challenge once in the Normandy Arena to obtain the initial points, and enter rankings for the new Season.
6. In the Normandy Arena, all boost effects will be disabled besides Officer level, Talent, and certain Outfits.

Battle Rules
1. The number of troops you can deploy each time is the same as your Troop Capacity, which you can increase by upgrading your HQ.
2. Each batch of troops is composed of the units provided by the system.
3. Your troops need to be placed in 8 tiles. Each unit will prioritize attacking the front row targets straight ahead, and they will attack the back row targets straight ahead. If there is no target straight ahead, they will attack the closest enemy troops.
4. You can achieve victory by defeating all enemy troops within the designated time. If you fail to eliminate enemy troops within the designated time, then the one who has more remaining units will win.
