LC_OTHER_PVE_ArrestRewardsText_Lv1: Tanya has briefed you on the basic information of the "Dark Night" incident, and asked you to prevent "Zero", the Terrorist organization from expanding.
LC_OTHER_PVE_ArrestRewardsText_Lv2: Tanya is a double agent?! After this battle, she will go undercover among the Terrorists for more detailed intelligence!
LC_OTHER_PVE_ArrestRewardsText_Lv3: The communications machine transmits Tanya's first piece of intelligence. It seems Tanya has successfully infiltrated into "Zero". Now fight the Terrorists based on the intelligence!
LC_OTHER_PVE_ArrestRewardsText_Lv4: Heavily wounded, Tanya brings valuable information that "Zero" is now intensely expanding! Please be extremely careful in attacking!
LC_OTHER_PVE_ArrestRewardsText_Lv5: The leader of "Zero" - "Faceless" Atlantis appears! He is commanding his forces to loot weapons and staff. Stop them!
LC_OTHER_PVE_ArrestRewardsText_Lv6: Tanya secretly sent a brief to you, disclosing the location where Terrorists are currently clustering. She reminds you to be vigilant of Atlantis's new plan.
LC_OTHER_PVE_ArrestRewardsText_Lv7: Tanya' s intelligence arrived in time. Jack seemed to recoil from fighting the Terrorists, however, how can you recoil and give up fighting? Just attack!
LC_OTHER_PVE_ArrestRewardsText_Lv8: Report from Jack that your troops have been ambushed by Terrorists, and have suffered heavy casualties! They need our immediate reinforcement now!
LC_OTHER_PVE_ArrestRewardsText_Lv9: Another transmission from Tanya was received, revealing that Jack might be a traitor! But Jack has long prepared for this moment and is ready to converge with Terrorists.
LC_OTHER_PVE_ArrestRewardsText_Lv10: "Faceless" Atlantis shows up, however, Tanya is tied up in the front. Should an excuse be needed to rescue her? Nothing can stop you even if it is a trap!
LC_OTHER_PVE_ArrestRewardsText_Lv11: Although Atlantis's complete Plan wasn't found, you've discovered 5 Terrorist cluster locations. Go wipe them out!
LC_OTHER_PVE_ArrestRewardsText_Lv12: Tanya discovered from the captured loot that Atlantis is on the verge of attacking the Central Lab! Go reinforce now!
LC_OTHER_PVE_ArrestRewardsText_Lv13: The previously repelled Terrorists refused to give up. They are preparing to launch forces for yet another contention on the Lab.
LC_OTHER_PVE_ArrestRewardsText_Lv14: The Terrorists' attacks continue unabated. However, Tanya suggests you research new arms to withstand the increasingly powerful Terrorists. Let's do it!
LC_OTHER_PVE_ArrestRewardsText_Lv15: The Terrorist forces amassed by Jack are ready to launch the final attack on the Lab. Battle is imminent! Prepare yourself before setting out!
LC_OTHER_PVE_ArrestRewardsText_Lv16: Atlantis appeared again and claimed to have built up a new military force. He suddenly unleashed gunfire at you... You were saved by Tanya, however, she's badly wounded.
LC_OTHER_PVE_ArrestRewardsText_Lv17: Awakened Tanya seems to have lost her memory. Poor Tanya... For Tanya, revenge!
LC_OTHER_PVE_ArrestRewardsText_Lv18: Although it is substitute officers that are now sending you intelligence, you are unable to forget the sound of Tanya's voice. Once this battle is over, try to get Tanya's memory back!
LC_OTHER_PVE_ArrestRewardsText_Lv19: You decide to take Tanya to a place nearby the Lab with troops, to try to recover her memory.
LC_OTHER_PVE_ArrestRewardsText_Lv20: Tanya finally recovers her memory. Not only that, she has recalled Atlantis's nuclear plan! Hurry up to Zone C7 and stop Atlantis now!
LC_OTHER_PVE_ArrestRewardsText_Lv21: Tanya has received new intelligence that Terrorists have divided forces in order to kidnap the Governor. You must stop this from happening!
LC_OTHER_PVE_ArrestRewardsText_Lv22: Tanya received new intelligence that Terrorists have divided forces to kidnap the Governor. They must be stopped!
LC_OTHER_PVE_ArrestRewardsText_Lv24: Terrorists have gradually been surrounding our base! Breach the encirclement, or this battle will be bound to lose!
LC_OTHER_PVE_ArrestRewardsText_Lv25: Finally getting furious as "Faceless" Atlantis is, he decides to give up on the hostage plan and turns full attention to launching the nuke! No time to delay, stop this maniac!

LC_OTHER_wingman_main_page_explain:
1. There are 5 qualities of Wingmen, i.e. White, Green, Blue, Purple, and Orange. 
2. Wingman sub-attributes unlock as Wingman level upgrades, but values of sub-attributes are fixed and won't be affected by Wingman level. 
3. The main attribute of Wingman Eagle, Starlight, and Hornet contains only one unit type's combat attribute respectively. However, the main attribute of Intrepid includes combat attributes of all three main unit types. 
4. Players can get Wingman from Wingman Supply Chests obtained by completing daily missions, participating in rebel activities or other certain activities, collecting Wingman supplies, and purchasing Wingman Supply Chests at the store.
LC_OTHER_wingman_upgrade_page_explain: 1. Locked wingman cannot be consumed for an upgrade. 2. Wingman with better quality and higher level provides more EXP. 3. Wingmen at Lv3 or below won't receive EXP loss.
LC_OTHER_wingman_modification_notice:
1. You can use the Transform function to reset unlocked sub-attributes.
2. Sub-attributes can be locked, but attributes locked will not be reset in a transform.
3. You can lock a maximum of 4 sub-attributes.

LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_GUIDE_NUM1: Commander, please allow me to lead you to the CTCC, the Counterterrorism Command Center.
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV1_NUM1: We'll always remember August 9, 2025, when the “Dark Night” incident occured.
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV1_NUM2: "Dark Night" incident was the most bitter terrorist attack in history to ever take place, when the Terrorist organization "Zero" destroyed governments all over the world almost overnight!
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV1_NUM3: Since the "Dark Night" incident, the world has sunk into a state of chaos without any government. I have just now received new information that "Zero" is spawning itself again!
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV1_NUM4: As a victim of “Dark Night" incident, I request you, commander, to exterminate them!
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV1_NUM5: Commander, we got luck this time. We <font color='#ffc000'>captured</font> quite a few <font color='#ffc000'>battle troops</font>. Now, our battle ability has again been enhanced!
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV1_NUM6: Both capturing prisoners from Terrorists and producing at the Armory are effective ways to enhance our power!
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV2_NUM1: Commander, there is something I must confess to you.
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV2_NUM2: Since the "Dark Night" incident, the Terrorist organization "Zero" as well as surviving governments have all reached out to me. So, simply speaking, I'm a double agent.
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV2_NUM3: I've decided to infiltrate into the inner depths of "Zero" after this extermination operation, to provide you with further intelligence!
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV3_NUM1: (The special communications machine has just received a dialogue video between Tanya and a senior "Zero" official)
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV3_NUM2: Sir, Field agent Tanya reporting to you!
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV3_NUM3: Well, well, well, isn't this our beautiful Tanya? How is it possible that you haven't brought along several handsome studs with you?
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV3_NUM4: Too bad, the handsome boys are all dead. Where is our leader? I need to talk with him.
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV3_NUM5: Guess what, it's also just too bad. Our leader is recruiting near Zone A3, for THAT plan. Ha ha ha!
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV4_NUM1: Commander! Please head to Zone C55 now! That's the real place "Zero" is expanding! Beware of their leader, “faceless” Atlantis!
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV4_NUM3: It doesn't matter! Just came across several numbskulls on my way here. I need to hurry back to them. My real identity should not yet have been revealed.
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV4_NUM4: (Leaving as Tanya finishes her words. The setting sun, however, casts her thin shadow back towards us...)
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV4_NUM5: Commander, please don't be content with just the current victory. It's beyond all imagination as to just how strong the Terrorists are. Developing the base is now of the utmost importance!
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV4_NUM6: As a symbol of base power, it's of prior importance for us to upgrade our <font color='#ffc000'>H.Q</font>!
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV5_NUM1: Leader, what a success! Now our men can be well equipped, no bare hands anymore!
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV5_NUM2: Ha ha ha! All these tanks, helicopters, and SUVs belong to me, Atlantis now!
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV5_NUM3: "Faceless" Atlantis, your plan has been exposed. Surrendering is your best choice!
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV5_NUM5: I'll do you a favor and send only 10% of my forces. Beat them, and you win! Hahahahaha!
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV5_NUM6: Commander, it's not a good thing to underestimate an enemy. We must expand our armed forces, or else, we may stand to lose next time he comes.
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV6_NUM1: (Beep, beep, beep...The Communications machine for receiving Tanya's intelligence rings again.)
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV6_NUM3: ("Atlantis is plotting out a terrible plan. Expanding his armed forces is just his first step.")
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV6_NUM4: ("Stop them, Commander! We must stop them right from the very start. Tanya begs you, Commander. please! They are now at Zone D26!"
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV6_NUM5: The sound of the communications machine rings again in the command room.
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV6_NUM6: (Tanya: Commander, Atlantis is soon going to launch a massive attack! Please be aware! Please be aware!)
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV6_NUM7: Commander, with all due respect, our current tactics are not suitable for tackling big enough battles.
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV6_NUM9: See, we have the War Simulator, which can be helpful in figuring out restrain relations among units.
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV7_NUM1: Commander! Tanya has just sent us the location intelligence of "Zero" again, but...
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV7_NUM3: I think if we continue to resist and fight against "Zero", it will only bring about their all out revenge. What if we just get over it all and reconcile?
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV7_NUM5: Easy, commander, I was just offering a more rational plan, whereas continuing to fight against "Zero" is definitely not a smart one.
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV7_NUM6: What's more, those independent forces are all turning a blind eye to the Terrorist organization.
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV7_NUM8: I need to continue my duties and wait for Tanya's intelligence. Commander, if you'd like to be alone, the Shooting Ground would be the best choice.
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV8_NUM1: Commander! Our troops have been ambushed by Terrorists! We are losing them! Remaining troops have now already been surrounded by Terrorists!
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV8_NUM4: Commander, I think you must have noticed, our troop production cannot keep pace with the expansion of Terrorists.
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV8_NUM5: If you can remember, the speedups we seized last time would come in real handy now! I suggest you use more at this moment!
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV9_NUM1: (Beep, beep, beep...The Communications machine for receiving Tanya's intelligence rings again.)
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV9_NUM2: ("This is Tanya, this is Tanya! Emergency! Emergency!")
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV9_NUM3: ("Jack could be a traitor! Jack could be a traitor!")
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV9_NUM4: Hmm, you got me, huh? What a pity that I couldn't find chance to kill you at the Shooting Ground last time!
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV9_NUM5: Never mind. My troops are on the way! Stop me if you can.
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV9_NUM6: Commander, a final piece of advice as your officer, Tanya has long been exposed. Get ready for her remains!
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV9_NUM7: Another thing, don't tell me you can't even take care of our base infiltrators. If so, you would have no chance to see me again. Sayonara, "commander".
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV10_NUM2: Hahahahaha! Tanya, my dear, what a perfect cover you had. Any last words?
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV10_NUM3: Just kill me! You crazy freak!
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV10_NUM4: No, no, no, my dear bait! See? Your commander is right here! Take a guess, will he come and rescue you?
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV10_NUM5: Commander, no, don't come! It's a trap!
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV10_NUM7: Why... to cost such a price, just to save me....
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV10_NUM9: No, I can't leave with you. It seems Atlantis is plotting an even more massive operation. I... I must find further intelligence!
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV10_NUM10: (Tanya's figure again disappears in the fire of battle, but this time her footsteps seem refracted with blinking tears.)
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV10_NUM11: (No one knows whether it was for persistence to keep striking Terrorists or for hiding her tears that Tanya turned around...)
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV11_NUM1: Thank you, Commander! You rescued me. That was a trap. You...)
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV11_NUM3: ....About "That Plan", still I couldn't dig out accurate intelligence, but what you can be sure of is, they have rallied 5 troops at Zone E41.
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV11_NUM5: I'm not sure this information is good enough to repay your rescue of last time, but...
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV11_NUM7: No no no, it's just too hot...hmm, it must be too...hot...
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV11_NUM8: So...I just want to say, thank you for saving my life! I will alway by your side...to...to gather intelligence!
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV11_NUM9: Any...anyway, please take these gifts! I'll work even harder in the future!
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV12_NUM1: Commander, about the last battle, seems we got something interesting - the Operation Plan of "Zero"!
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV12_NUM2: Seems they are planning to attack the central Lab, soon! Are we marching to the Lab?
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV12_NUM4: That's weird. Something is wrong here. There should be more forces than this.
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV12_NUM5: Commander, let's enhance our scouting technique, for better knowledge of our enemy.
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV14_NUM1: Commander...I think we should get some new toys.
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV14_NUM2: Hmm, no no no, Tanya was saying that we can develop some new arms. Seems these Terrorists are researching new arms, too.
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV14_NUM3: Oh, no! They are attacking the Lab again! Let's reinforce!
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV14_NUM4: The Central Lab has sent the up-to-date Helicopter design drawing in appreciation of our reinforcement.
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV14_NUM5: We can research it, so that the attack of our Helicopters can be improved greatly!
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV15_NUM1: Tanya, my dear, it's been a long time. Well, you are at the Lab, too? A scientist you are now?
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV15_NUM2: Traitor! What do you want in the Lab?
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV15_NUM3: Oh? I thought you knew "That Plan". In this case, I'm much relieved now. Full attack!
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV15_NUM4: Heavens, what a fierce battle. Though we were nearly broken through, we eventually retook the Central Lab.
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV15_NUM5: However, people in the Lab said that Jack may have looted lots of advanced design drawings. So, to confront with them, the Lab designed the new drawing of Tank - Grizzly!
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV15_NUM6: So, we got a new toy! Let's make some of them! Haha!
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV15_NUM8: Uh...I mean let's make some Grizzly Tanks!
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV16_NUM1: Hahaha, look what we got at the Lab! Let's try it out!
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV16_NUM3: Oh? Isn't this Tanya's commander? You've come just at the right moment! Let's just try my new weapon on him! Ha ha ha! Forces... fire!
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV16_NUM4: (Tanya flung upon you in that instant...)
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV16_NUM6: (The blast wave from the explosion shocks Tanya into unconsciousness )
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV17_NUM1: Where... Where am I?... Who am I?
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV18_NUM1: Salute, Commander! This is the location of the Terrorists. Please decide whether or not to attack!
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV18_NUM2: (Not having the intelligence signed off by Tanya, seems very strange.)
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV18_NUM6: I... I don't know. There's some drawings in my head... some kind of new weapon...
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV19_NUM1: Central Lab... No, it's not Artillery, but something more powerful...
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV19_NUM2: Take me to the front, maybe I can remember something.
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV19_NUM4: (The bell sounds again warning that Terrorists are sneaking in...)
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV19_NUM5: They dare to come again?! For the drawings?
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV19_NUM8: (Shooting through the air in a flash, the bullet penetrates Tanya's shoulder who stands in front of you.)
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV20_NUM3: Commander... I think I've got my memory back!
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV20_NUM4: Not only that, now I remember, "Faceless" Atlantis is going to make a nuclear bomb!
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV20_NUM5: Raising troops was for getting forces to attack the Lab. Attacking the Lab was for stealing nuclear tech. The nuclear will be built on Greenland!
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV20_NUM7: Look who I've brought, Miss Lisa is a senior scientific researcher. She has been specially dispatched by the Central Lab to be our advisor!
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV21_NUM1: Hahaha, Tanya, my dear, how did you find this place?
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV21_NUM2: Simple, expand forces, attack the Lab, seize Greenland, isn't all this for the nuclear bomb!
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV21_NUM3: Smart girl! But it's really a pity you can't give me your allegiance. But seeing as you found your way here, try and attack!
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV21_NUM4: But I must remind you, it will only be 3 days before the nuclear is completed! So, just come and attack! Ha ha ha!
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV22_NUM1: Commander, a message from Central Government, Terrorists have surrounded the Government building!
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV22_NUM2: Damn! That's why Atlantis deliberately told us the time left for making the nuclear bomb. He was trying to hold us up here.
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV22_NUM3: Commander, are we staying here or going back to rescue them?
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV24_NUM1: Commander, Atlantis has surrounded us. I think we'd better crush them one by one.
LC_OTHER_WANTED_STORY_LV25_NUM1: You! You think you can prevent me from kidnapping the Governor and from launching the nuclear bomb? Naive!

LC_POPBOX_PVE_info:
1. Attacking Invaders only consumes Action Points. Your troops will not become damaged.
2. You must defeat lower-level Invaders before you can attack higher-level Invaders.
3. Invaders are common troops that you can attack at any time to get a large amount of rewards.
4. 1 Action Point is restored every 2 minutes.

LC_POPBOX_PVE_info_activity:
Chimera Divisions are the Invader's experimental troops. Their powerful weaponry can crush just about anything, so they can be only be defeated by rallying strong forces.

1. Your troops will only become lightly damaged from battling with Chimera Divisions. Lightly damaged troops will be repaired after returning to Base.
2. Attacking Chimera Divisions costs a lot of Action Points. They can only be attacked with Rally Attacks.
3. After defeating a Pandora Division, all participants will be rewarded. Each participant's rewards are completely random.
LC_POPBOX_PVE_info_city:
Cerberus Legions are the Invaders' elite troops. They are formidable in battle and fear nothing. They garrison near Cities, so you must face them if you want to liberate a City.

1. Attacking Cerberus Legions will not consume any Action Points.
2. Cerberus Legions will refresh daily at 00:00, 06:00, 12:00, and 18:00 UTC.
3. Defeat Cerberus Legions to earn lots of Officer XP. Cerberus Legions will also drop Badges. Gather them to obtain powerful bonuses.

LC_POPBOX_PVE_info_01:
Cyclopes are the Invader's military strongholds, which are equipped with heavy weapons that can destroy anything. You will need to assemble a batch of strong troops to eliminate them.
 
 1. Attacking Cyclopes will cost 150 Action Points each time, and your troops will not die during the attacks.
 2. Cyclopes can only be rally attacked after you join a Guild.
 3. Pay attention to Zone Mission, which can tell you when higher level Cyclopes appear on the map.
 4. Defeat Cyclopes to obtain amazing rewards. The stronger you are, the better the rewards will be.
 5. Keep your eyes on the Cyclops countdown. It won't just stay there and wait for you, so make sure you defeat it before it retreats.
LC_POPBOX_ExerciseRhine_Enemy_Info:
A unit from Rhineland Exercise. Defeat it to challenge higher-level Exercise Troops.

1. Only the Commander who summoned the Exercise Troops can challenge them—unless the Commander uses Help Request Tickets.
2. Your troops will only become lightly damaged from battling with Exercise Troops. Lightly damaged troops will be repaired after returning to Base.
3. Attacking Exercise Troops costs Action Points, which will be restored gradually over time.
4. You can attack Exercise Troops on your own or through Rally attacks.
5. You will get a massive amount of Officer XP from solo attacks. From Rally attacks, you will obtain lots of resources plus Help Request Tickets at a certain chance.
6. You can only challenge higher-difficulty Exercise Troops after defeating Exercise Troops at the current level.
LC_POPBOX_ExerciseRhine_Boss_Info:
A Boss from the Exercise Rhineland. Defeat it to obtain amazing rewards.

1. Only the Guild that summons the Boss can challenge.
2. Each Commander can only send one batch of troops to join the attack.
3. Commanders who participated in the attack will obtain rewards after the Boss is defeated.
LC_POPBOX_Troops_FullAttention_Text1: Your march queues are full. Get more march queues by upgrading your HQ. You can also deploy other troops that are currently out on missions.
LC_POPBOX_B2_RW_buff_info:
The Badges dropped by Redwolf Legions can provide powerful bonuses. Please note:
1. You can only have one Badge effect at a time. Any newly obtained Badge effect will replace the old one.
2. One Badge can be obtained by several Commanders. Once obtained, the Badge effects will apply to all units.
3. Each Badge has a countdown, and the Badge will disappear when the countdown ends.

LC_POPBOX_PrizeCenter_info_D:
1. The system will distribute some rewards through the Rewards Center. Players will receive rewards even if they are not online. 

2. The storage limit of the Rewards Center is 200. When the limit is exceeded, older rewards will be replaced, please receive your rewards in time. 

3. Rewards distributed through the Rewards Center include: Monthly Subscription, Event reward, System compensation, gifts from other players, etc.
LC_POPBOX_Map_Info:
Teleport: transfer your Base to another tile. (During Non-PvP period, player cannot use Advanced Teleport or Territory Teleport and move to the enemy territory.)
Encamp: move your Units to a tile and conduct camping, it does not affect the ownership of tile.
Occupy: move your Units to this tile and conduct Territory Occupation, after a period, your Guild will obtain the control of the tile, and it will become Guild's territory. The Resource Points within Guild territory will produce additional resources into Resource Bank, and accelerate your gather speed.
LC_POPBOX_Shield_Rule_D:
1.When you send troops to launch an attack, occupy territory, encamp, participate in the Rally, Defend, or Reinforce, you won’t be able to activate the shield.

2.When the Unit Reserve Center is holding units of other players, you won’t be able to activate the shield

3. A Governor cannot activate a Peace Shield. Once a player becomes the Governor, his/her current Peace Shield will be automatically disabled.

LC_POPBOX_TT_info:
*The Top Territory can be occupied by any guild from any zone on this continent.

*After a guild occupies the Top Territory, all the guild members can enjoy the buff brought by doing so.

*You can only attack the Top Territory during the activity period. 

*One guild can only occupy one Top territory.

*In Top Territory, if a player changes to another guild, he will immediately be sent back to his original zone.
LC_POPBOX_Setwar_notice1: Only guild leaders can declare war.
LC_POPBOX_Setwar_notice2: The war declaration has been successfully made! Please prepare yourself for battle!
LC_POPBOX_TT_info2:
*The ruling rights to this territory can be acquired by occupying the Council. The occupying guild‘s leader will become the Council Chairman. 

*The attacking party can occupy the Council after defeating the defending party. The defending party has to defend the attack for 12 hours or wait until the end of the activity to gain the ruling rights. 

*The guild members with their commander inside the Council will automatically become the defense captains, all buffs for the Council defending party are gained from defense captains. 

*The troop capacity of Council is 2,375,000, and the maximum capacity of Hall of War when attacking the Council will also be limited to 2,375,000.

*In the following 5 days after acquiring ruling rights, all ruling guild members can teleport into the territory where the Council is located at any time. 

*All members of the guild occupying the Council will enjoy the buffs provided by the Council, no matter whether their bases are in this territory or not. 

*All resources gathered in the territory will have an extra 10% of the total entered into the occupying guild's Resource Bank.

*There will be much higher battle losses on the Top Territory.
LC_POPBOX_PP_info1:
*The ruling right of the Presidential Palace can be acquired by occupying the Presidential Palace. The occupying guild‘s leader will become the President who rules over all of the zones!!

*The attacking party can occupy the Presidential Palace after defeating the defending party. The defending party has to defend the attack for 3 days to gain ruling rights.

*The guild members with their commander inside the Presidential Palace will automatically become the defense captains, all buffs for the Presidential Palace defending party are gained from defense captains.

*The President can title all the zones except for the Top Territory, the players of the said zones will be affected by the zone title.

*In the following 5 days after acquiring ruling rights, all ruling guild members can teleport into the territory where the Presidential Palace is located at any time.

*All members of the guild occupying the Presidential Palace will enjoy the buffs provided by the Presidential Palace, no matter whether their bases are in this territory or not.

*All resources gathered in the territory will have an extra 10% of the total entered into the occupying guild's Resource Bank.

*When the main base is inside the Presidential Palace territory, the Hall of War and Unit Reserve Center's capacity will be increased by 100%. Meanwhile, the battle loss ratio will increase. 

*The troop capacity of President Palace is 4,750,000, and the maximum capacity of Hall of War when attacking the President Palace will also be limited to 4,750,000.
LC_POPBOX_War_info1:
*A guild can declare war once to compete for one Top Territory per activity.

*Only after a guild has made a war declaration can its members enter the territory for which they have declared war.

*Only guilds of level 30 or above can declare war.

*Once having made the war declaration, a guild cannot revoke the declaration. Also, a war declaration costs 30,000,000 Cash.

LC_POPBOX_UD_tips: Are you sure you want to participate in Extreme Defense? Terrorists will start marching and attacking your base from their current location.
LC_POPBOX_UD_info:
* When Extreme Defense begins, Terrorist Bases will be refreshed on the map. Guild Leaders can select a Terrorist Base and start a round of Extreme Defense.
* Then Terrorist Bases will send troops to randomly attack guild members. Commanders can get points by defending their base or reinforcing guild members' bases to kill enemy troops.
* Terrorists do not plunder Commanders' resources. However, small amounts of losses (units) will be incurred, which will enter the Garage. Lost Reinforcements will also be sent to their own Garage. (Please make sure there is enough capacity in Garage, since units exceeding the capacity will be permanently "lost".)
* If Commanders lose during Extreme Defense, they will no longer be attacked by Terrorists. Players can activate a Peace Shield to announce giving up.
* Once a Guild has activated the activity, newly joined Commanders will not be able to get any points or be attacked by Terrorists.
* Once a Guild has activated the activity, newly signed up Commanders will not be attacked by Terrorists, but they can get points through reinforcement.
* While the activity is ongoing, Commanders who quit the Guild or join another Guild will have their personal points reset to zero. If Terrorists are attacking you while you are quitting the current guild or joining another one, you will be taken as lost the Extreme Defense activity.
* Rewards will be sent to Rewards Center when the activity is over.

Your troops sent to reinforce other members that are damaged will enter your own Garage too. LC_VIDEO_video_channel_create_info_desc:
Ready to submit your YouTube/TikTok video to Dead Empire Channel?

There are tons of perks to adding your videos to Dead Empire Channel. For example, after approval, every video view on YouTube/TikTok earns you 1 V-Coin. The more views your videos get, the more V-Coin you'll receive!

Here are a few things to know before submitting your videos:

1. It's for Everyone:
Your video has to be about Dead Empire, but you don't need to be a pro YouTuber. We accept any videos as long as they're about Dead Empire.

2. Video Approval:
After you submit your YouTube/TikTok video, the Dead Empire team will review it to make sure the content is about Dead Empire and follows platform and Dead Empire rules. The review usually takes 1-7 days.

3. V-Coin Reward:
Once your video is approved, you'll earn V-Coin for new views on YouTube/TikTok. The current rate is 1 V-Coin per view. The numbers update every hour.

4. Get More Followers:
Dead Empire Channel shows your videos to our players, helping you get more subscribers and followers on YouTube and TikTok.

5. Your Content, Your Responsibility:
Only add videos you made yourself. You're responsible for your content. Breaking the rules could limit your account.

6. Rule Changes:
Dead Empire may change the rules in the future. By using the app, you agree to follow the current rules and any future changes.

---------------------------------
Extra Note:
*Reward starts when the video is submitted and approved on Dead Empire Channel, the previous views of the video would not be included. 
*If you remove the video from Dead Empire, the video stops generate rewards, but you can still claim the rewards already generated.
*The third-party data service used by Dead Empire includes anti-cheat mechanisms, which strictly monitor and filter view data to provide a more accurate assessment of interactions. As a result, the number of views reported may differ from the original data on the video platform.
*Dead Empire may apply limits over the maximum reward a video can get.
*Certain actions may lead to account banning and reward removal, for example faking views, using other people's videos, spamming videos and etc.
*Dead Empire may change the rules in the future. By using the app, you agree to follow the rules and any future changes.
LC_VIDEO_video_channel_creator_info_desc:
Creators are players who have added their YouTube/TikTok videos to the Dead Empire Channel.
In Dead Empire Channel, creators not only earn V-Coin rewards every time their video is played on YouTube/TikTok, but also get more exposure as Dead Empire players check out the videos and become YouTube subscribers and TikTok followers.

Here are a few things to know about becoming a Creator:

1. It's for Everyone:
You don't have to be a pro YouTuber to become a creator on Dead Empire Channel. Just make videos about Dead Empire in your own style, upload them to YouTube or TikTok, and link the video to Dead Empire Channel. You'll become a creator!

2. Video Requirements:
All submitted videos go through an approval process to ensure they meet our basic requirements. These include: the video must be about Dead Empire and must not violate any platform or Dead Empire rules.

3. V-Coin Reward:
Once your video is approved, you will earn V-Coin for new views on YouTube/TikTok. The current rate is 1 V-Coin per video view. The numbers update every hour.

4. Get More Followers:
Dead Empire Channel showcases your videos to our players, helping you get more subscribers and followers on YouTube and TikTok.

5. Your Content, Your Responsibility:
Only add videos you made yourself. You're responsible for your content. Breaking the rules could limit your account.

6. Rule Changes:
Dead Empire may change the rules in the future. By using the app, you agree to follow the rules and any future changes.

---------------------------------
Extra Note:
*Reward starts when the video is submitted and approved on Dead Empire Channel, the previous views of the video would not be included. 
*If you remove the video from Dead Empire, the video stops generate rewards, but you can still claim the rewards already generated.
*Dead Empire uses its own algorithm to filter repeated and fake views, your video views might be different from the views on the video platforms. 
*Dead Empire may apply limits over the maximum reward a video can get.
*Certain actions may lead to account banning and reward removal, for example faking views, using other people's videos, spamming videos and etc.
*Dead Empire may change the rules in the future. By using the app, you agree to follow the rules and any future changes.

LC_VIDEO_window_video_channel_create_fun: Creating a Dead Empire video and earn V-Coins is easy, it also helps you get more subscribers! Here are the steps you need to take:
LC_VIDEO_window_video_channel_create_ins:
Create a video introducing Dead Empire! It can be casual or serious, and you can even just use screen recording.

Making videos about Dead Empire not only earns you V-Coins but also attracts new subscribers to your channel!

Check out some great examples below.

Dead Empire Channel is where you showcase your videos to players and earn V-Coin rewards. Your videos stay on your YouTube channel or TikTok account.

1. Upload to YouTube or TikTok:
First, upload your video to your YouTube channel or TikTok account.

2. Make Your Channel Public:
Make sure your channel/account is set to public and your video is publicly accessible before submitting it to Dead Empire Channel.

There will be a text verification stage where we verify your ownership over the video, so make sure you only submit videos of your own.

Submitting your video to Dead Empire Channel is super easy, and we'll guide you through the process.

1. Get Your Video URL:
You need the URL of your YouTube or TikTok video.

2. Add Verification Text:
Make sure to include the verification text in your video description.

3. Review Process:
After you submit, there will be a short review period. The Dead Empire team will check your video to make sure it meets the requirements. This usually takes 1-7 days.

Once your video is approved, every new view on YouTube or TikTok will earn you V-Coin rewards. For every 1 view, you get 1 V-Coin, with no cap! Just sit back and watch the numbers grow! 

Sharing the video with your friends will get you even more views!

The rewards will be automatically added to your Earning Balance, and you can claim them anytime you like.

A video is worth a thousand words! That's why we need more videos : )
Check out the video for a more detailed walkthrough.
1. Create a video about Dead Empire
2. Upload the video on YouTube or TikTok
3. Add the video in Dead Empire

LC_VIDEO_window_video_channel_shop_info_:
In the V-Coin Store, use the V-Coins you earn from creating videos to exchange for a variety of in-game rewards!

Below is the Exchange Guide:

1. Product Categories
Store goods are divided into four types:

Limited Goods: Rare items, usually with exchange limits

Weekly Goods: Limited exchanges, inventory refreshes weekly

Daily Goods: Limited exchanges, updated daily

Standard Goods: Unlimited supply, exchange anytime

2. Exchange Process
Directly use V-Coins in the V-Coin Store to exchange for your desired goods. Once the exchange is successful, the items will be immediately delivered to your game account.

3. How to Earn V-Coins
Create Dead Empire-related videos on YouTube or TikTok and submit them for review to the official channel. Once your video is approved, you will earn 1 V-Coin for every view it receives on YouTube/TikTok! The more views your video gets, the more V-Coin rewards you will receive!
LC_VIDEO_Window_Video_Channel_info_text:
Dead Empire Channel is the perfect place to check out awesome videos about Dead Empire. You can also create your own videos and earn V-Coins every time someone watches them. It's super fun and rewarding!

Cool things about Dead Empire Channel:

1. Use Popular Platforms:
All videos are on YouTube, TikTok, and other popular sites. Dead Empire Channel lets you watch them all in one place. If you're a creator, upload your videos on YouTube or TikTok first, then add them to Dead Empire Channel.

2. Video Requirements:
Videos must be about Dead Empire and meet basic quality and length standards. Don't worry, these rules are easy for both new and experienced creators.

3. Everyone Can Join:
We want everyone to join the fun and earn rewards. To keep things fair, all videos will be reviewed before they go live.

4. Earn V-Coins:
After your video is approved, you earn 1 V-Coins for every new view on YouTube or TikTok. More views mean more V-Coins! The reward updates every hour and there might be delay.

5. Get More Followers:
Dead Empire Channel shows your videos to our players, helping you get more subscribers and followers on YouTube and TikTok.

6. Your Content, Your Responsibility:
Only add videos you made yourself. You're responsible for your content. Breaking the rules could limit your account.

7. Rule Changes:
Dead Empire may change the rules in the future. By using the app, you agree to follow the rules and any future changes.

Tutorial_Research_4: Okay! Getting potential projects started is a pressing matter at the moment!
Tutorial_Research_5: Here's some information on the projects, and it's really detailed.

Tutorial_Research_8: Here you can see the potential revenue this project generates.

Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_1: After three days of battle, we've finally taken this city. It's our base now. The Invaders are still out there ready to assault us any time, but at least we can have some peace for the moment.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_2: Ravaged by constant war, all cities have become barren and destitute. As the Commander of this city, it is my duty to protect it.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_29: Attention! You have 30 minutes to get out of this city. We're taking it over!
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_32: Not only Tanks, but air support too? We can't handle this, retreat!
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_35: And just like that, {0} went missing... I scoured the area, but found only twisted metal and debris. I kept looking for {0} until one day, I received a note.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_36:
GIVE UP THE CITY OR SHE'S DEAD
That's all that was written on the photo.
I regret that I didn't hold her back that day.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_37: I have rescue her, but I can't lead the troops on my own. I know someone who can help me. I have faith in her.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_38: Hi, Commander! Need me to fix something?
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_41: This is a good spot for a Garage. Be quick. We set out immediately after these Tanks are repaired!
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_44: Alright, sorry about that. You're a great Commander. I was just anxious.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_46: No, I don't. We just need to search for her bit by bit. If we destroy all the Invaders we find, I'm sure we find some clues.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_47: These Invaders are just asking for trouble! Let's start with them!
Tutorial_Opening_BGStory1: European nations have been embroiled in war for years.
Tutorial_Opening_BGStory2: The evil Invaders took advantage of the situation and rose up. Europe will soon be swallowed up by darkness.
Tutorial_Opening_BGStory3: Only the bravest of the resistance troops are still standing to fight against them.
Tutorial_Opening_BGStory4: You, together with them, are the only hope for Europe!
Tutorial_New_Fte_Option_2: Can we build a Tank Armory?
Tutorial_New_Fte_Feedback_5: Marjorie thinks you aren't doing your duty.
Tutorial_New_Fte_Feedback_7: Marjorie can't wait to start searching.

Tutorial_New_Chapter_4_content: We need to share information on Pandora tanks with other forces and find out how to deal with them. We need allies. Join or create a Guild, mobilize all forces to decode Pandora's secret and take out our enemies!
Tutorial_New_Chapter_2_Dialog_5: Awaiting your orders, Commander! Now it's an emergency. Assign me to manage resources, and I will find ways to increase resource output.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_3_Dialog_10: I don't have anything to do now, Commander. We're just waiting for construction to complete. Any way we can speed that up?
Tutorial_New_Chapter_3_Dialog_12: Oh, it's as simple as that? With speedups, we'll definitely take the lead!
Tutorial_New_Chapter_3_Dialog_22: Thanks to that intelligence you captured, the Invader base is in utter chaos right now! I took the chance and escaped. I'm on my way to your base right now!
Tutorial_New_Chapter_4_Dialog_16: Thanks for your help, Commander! Evelyn, at your command!
Tutorial_New_Chapter_Hero_Back_Content: Don't worry, Commander. I'm trying to get to your base as fast as I can to support you!
Tutorial_New_Chapter_Hero_Back_Desc: When the countdown ends, {0} will arrive at your City and join it.
Tutorial_Fte_CG_WouldOutlook_1: 1941, the Invaders launched a Blitzkrieg and swept over all of Europe.
Tutorial_Fte_CG_WouldOutlook_2: Countries fell one after another. Cities small and large were all occupied by the Invaders.
Tutorial_Fte_CG_WouldOutlook_4: The Soviet forces held their positions, while the US Army arrived on their ships.
Tutorial_Fte_CG_WouldOutlook_5: As a Commander, you led your ladies through hell and back to recapture a city from the enemy.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_2_content_a: The resistance is getting stronger, and the secrets of Chimera will be finally revealed. But before that, you have to make your Officers even more powerful.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_2_Dialog_2_a: Evelyn? Is that the Officer you mentioned who's still being held by the Invaders?
Tutorial_New_Chapter_2_Dialog_6_a: It's time to find out Officer Evelyn's location, besides I'm quite curious about what exactly Project Chimera is.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_3_content_a: A letter from a mysterious woman. Who is she, exactly? Why would she risk this if she belongs to the Invaders? We must become stronger if we want to help Evelyn escape.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_3_Dialog_1_a: {0}, don't be surprised that I know your name. And trust me, you have no idea what else I know.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_3_Dialog_2_a: Don't try to guess who I am. Rescuing Evelyn is what we need to focus on now. I can help her escape, but I need you to distract the Invaders.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_3_Dialog_3_a: You need to make that happen so that Evelyn can stand a chance of escaping. As for me, I believe we'll meet soon.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_3_Dialog_6_a: Well done! Evelyn has escaped from the Invaders, and she'll arrive at your location in {0} hour(s), as planned.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_3_Dialog_7_a: Keep fighting against Chimera. I look forward to meeting you.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_4_Dialog_1_a: Please make sure to destroy Chimera, Commander.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_4_Dialog_2_a: They're special troops the Invaders developed in secret. They're powerful, but what's worse is that they're virtually everywhere.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_4_Dialog_3_a: Each Chimera troop's location is hidden among different Invader troops.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_4_Dialog_4_a: Trust me, you cannot easily destroy Chimera on your own. You need to make allies with other Commanders, and fight against it together.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_4_Dialog_6_a: That's right! Find it and rally with your Guild to destroy it!
Tutorial_New_Chapter_4_content_a: With the intel Evelyn gathered, the secrets of Chimera are starting to unravel. This could be the key to turning the tide. But we need allies. Join or create a Guild, so we can have enough strength to fight against Chimera.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_Hero_Back_ready: Thanks for your help, Commander. I have to wait for the plane to return to your base.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_3_Dialog_8_a: Evelyn's intel on Project Chimera is recorded on this tape. She asked me to bring it to you.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_3_Dialog_9_a: I hope what we've done can really help Evelyn.
Tutorial_Soldier_ChooseAgent_1:
Commander, to get you acquainted with the base more quickly,
please choose an assistant to assist you in your work.

Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_mc_penelope_6: As you requested, I've investigated the city surroundings. The situation is worse than we expected.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_mc_penelope_7: You need even more explanation? Briefing isn't my forte.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_mc_penelope_8: Alright, I hope you can understand me.

Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_mc_penelope_11: We must bolster our defenses to resist them.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_mc_penelope_12: I know you've got a plan for this. After all, you're the one who led us to take back the city. I certainly don't want to be taken captive.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_mc_penelope_13: We'd better develop more advanced weapons. These ordinary troops are starting to make me feel unsafe.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_mc_penelope_14: Tanks? Great, I like those big guys because they'll strike fear into the hearts of our enemies.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_mc_penelope_15: I'm so excited at the thought of having this kind of super weapon. Hurry up and finish production!
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_mc_penelope_16: Oh, sorry. I got too excited. Let's hurry up and build the Tank Armory.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_mc_penelope_17: This is the perfect spot for building a Tank Armory. I looked over the city and picked out this area just for you.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_mc_penelope_18: Wow! Our own Tank Armory! Let's produce some and take them out for a ride! These big guys made me feel so safe.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_mc_penelope_19: Tap [Produce] to start producing Tanks. The Armory capacity is low right now, but we can still produce 20 at once.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_mc_penelope_20:
That's it! Tanks! With these, we'll win for sure!
It's been such a great day. Wanna have a drink with me, Commander?

Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_49: The map shows Linda is imprisoned in a base of Invaders. I know this location, but I'm afraid we can't take her out with the troops we have now.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_50: To deal with enemies at this level, I've got a plan. We need to do these things first before we can save Linda.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_52: Thank you, Commander. I knew you'd come for me.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_53: By the way, when I was captured, I overheard them talking about some plan code-named Pandora. It seems like they've also captured other senior Officers. We must keep an eye on them.
Tutorial_New_Fte_Option_4: Do you know where is Linda?
Tutorial_New_Fte_Feedback_2: Linda is glad you agree with her
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_54: Commander, it's not time for this. We need to save Linda first!
Tutorial_New_Chapter_2_content: Pandora, a highly classified plan, could be the key to victory in this war. But now, we have no surplus left to rescue Evelyn. The entire base is short on supplies. We need Food to make cans and Steel to forge weapons.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_3_content: With Evelyn's telegram, Pandora's secret has begun to surface. This could be the key to ending the Invaders!
Tutorial_New_Chapter_2_Dialog_1: What? Aren't going to save Evelyn, Commander? I don't need any rest at all!
Tutorial_New_Chapter_2_Dialog_2: I understand how you feel, but we don't have enough resources—neither Food nor Steel.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_2_Dialog_3: I didn't know war could cost so much... But Evelyn is in danger, and we can't leave her behind.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_2_Dialog_4: Calm down, Linda. We can work together, restore the base, and then rescue Evelyn as soon as we can.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_2_Dialog_6: Hi, Commander! There are some areas around the base that can be used to build resource buildings. Let's use them.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_2_Dialog_7: But it's far from enough to rely only on resources produced at the base. There are troves of resources outside the base, too. Try gathering some, Commander!
Tutorial_New_Chapter_2_Dialog_8: I can lead troops to gather resources outside the base.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_2_Dialog_9: It's time-consuming work, so first specify the target to gather, and I'll handle the rest.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_2_Dialog_10: Well done, Commander. Our Food storage has increased by quite a lot. Now we can say goodbye to canned food.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_2_Dialog_11: Steel storage has also increased. It won't be long before we can forge more weapons.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_2_Dialog_12: We have to set out to look for Officer Evelyn now. I want to get to the bottom of this Project Pandora.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_2_Dialog_13: Sorry to interrupt, Commander, but I've gotten in touch with Evelyn! This telegram is from her!
Tutorial_New_Chapter_3_Dialog_1: Linda, please, you must tell your Commander about this.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_3_Dialog_2: I'm being forced to participate in Project Pandora, which involves solving the technical challenges necessary to manufacture Pandora tanks.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_3_Dialog_3: A team carrying classified Pandora documents left the research lab just yesterday. If you can attack the Invaders and find the encrypted notes, you can unveil the secrets of those powerful Pandora tanks!
Tutorial_New_Chapter_3_Dialog_4: If you succeed, it will throw the Invaders here into chaos, and I might be able to find a chance to escape.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_3_Dialog_5: We need to find those documents. Everyone's afraid of those Pandora tanks, but if their secrets are exposed, then more forces will rise up to join the resistance. Wish us luck, Commander!
Tutorial_New_Chapter_3_Dialog_6: Now we can produce Anti-tank Guns.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_3_Dialog_7: With these units, we can deal with enemy tanks easily. It would be even better if we had an Officer that excelled at leading Anti-tank Gun troops.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_3_Dialog_8: Are you any good with Anti-tank Guns?
Tutorial_New_Chapter_3_Dialog_9: No, not me. What I like more is the firepower that Tanks bring to the table. But I do know some Officers who are experts in Anti-tank Guns. You'll meet them later.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_3_Dialog_13: Commander, upgrade armory technology to increase unit production speed.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_3_Dialog_14: Great, now we can produce more units! I hope someday these can become automobile factories again. I like tanks, and I like convertibles even more—but we don't have any choice right now.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_3_Dialog_15: Try to cause some extra trouble for the enemy so they won't notice what our real goal is.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_3_Dialog_16: Hey, that's it! The intelligence is intact! We found it!
Tutorial_New_Chapter_3_Dialog_17: These classified documents are related to the design of the Pandora tanks—precisely the weapon that helped the Invaders win the war.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_3_Dialog_18: I've seen Pandora tanks, and they're total nightmares. I'd never want to encounter another one.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_3_Dialog_19: No design is perfect. With these documents, we can find its Achilles' heel.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_4_Dialog_4: We've decoded the secret of the Pandora tanks. They're powerful, but far from invincible. There are some weak spots at the rear, and hitting any one of them will make the tank burst into flames!
Tutorial_New_Chapter_4_Dialog_5: That's useful info. If we had enough people and we worked together, we could surround the Pandora tanks and attack their weak spots from the rear. We need more men, Commander!
Tutorial_New_Chapter_4_Dialog_6: Looks like we need a Guild. The seeds of resistance will never die! We're not alone here, so let's unite our forces and fight together!
Tutorial_New_Chapter_4_Dialog_7: Commander, we can join a Guild or create a new one. It's up to you. Ready to make some friends?
Tutorial_New_Chapter_4_Dialog_8: Let me tell you some more about Guilds.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_4_Dialog_9: The most obvious benefit is that we can reduce construction times for Guild members by sending Guild Help. Of course, they can also return the favor.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_4_Dialog_10: All Guild members can earn Territory Wages through Guild Territory, and the amount correlates with size of your Guild Territory. Of course, only the Guild Leader and Officials can expand your Guild Territory.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_1_Dialog_1: This request probably seems a bit a sudden, but I know an Officer called Evelyn who's now being held captive in an Invader base. She's being forced to participate in Project Pandora, so we need to rescue her as well.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_3_Dialog_20: Don't fear those Pandora tanks. I'll help you.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_3_Dialog_21: Evelyn? Is that Evelyn over the radio?
Tutorial_New_Chapter_4_Dialog_11: Guild members can donate to boost Guild Technology, which benefits all members.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_4_Dialog_12: That's all, Commander. Now it's time for you to connect with some allies.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_4_Dialog_13: Now we're ready to fight Pandora!
Tutorial_New_Chapter_4_Dialog_14: Now we just need to wait for them to arrive!
Tutorial_New_Chapter_4_Dialog_15: Our victory will inspire everyone to rise up, and the fire of resistance will burn ever brighter!
Tutorial_New_Chapter_3_Dialog_6_1: Now we can produce Tank Destroyers.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_3_Dialog_7_1: With these units, we can deal with enemy tanks easily. It would be even better if we had an Officer that excelled at leading Tank Destroyer troops.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_3_Dialog_8_1: Are you any good with Tank Destroyers?
Tutorial_New_Chapter_2_Dialog_1_a: I'm back and ready for action, Commander! I think we should find clues as soon as possible, and rescue Evelyn!
Tutorial_New_Chapter_2_Dialog_3_a: Yes. Invaders are working on Project Pandora in secret, and as a doctor, Evelyn used to treat the wounded military officers responsible for the project because of her humanity. She will be the key to destroying the project.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_2_Dialog_4_a: Slow down, Linda. The Invaders are getting stronger every day, so we must fully prepare ourselves before saving others.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_2_Dialog_5_a: You're right. The Invaders' power is starting to worry me. Give the order, Commander. I'm sure you can make us stronger!
Tutorial_New_Chapter_2_Dialog_7_a: Commander, we've just received a mysterious letter... with Evelyn's location on it!
Tutorial_New_Chapter_3_Dialog_4_a: Commander, a plane from the Government is heading towards us. Could it be Evelyn?
Tutorial_New_Chapter_4_title_a: With the intel Evelyn gathered, the secrets of Pandora are starting to unravel. This could be the key to turning the tide. But we need allies. Join or create a Guild, so we can have enough strength to fight against Pandora.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_4_Dialog_5_a: All set. Now we just have to wait for the Pandora to come.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_4_Dialog_7_a: Let's keep developing and getting stronger before the Pandora is here.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_3_Dialog_10_a: Commander, we've received another letter, just like the last one.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_23_b: Oh... Hi, Commander, you're here! That's a present in your hand. Is that for me?
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_27_b: Commander! Allow me to attack them!
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_29_b: Roger that! I'll get myself ready now!
Tutorial_New_Fte_mc_lawrence_chat_5: Commander, recruit Riven at your command!
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_mc_lawrence_29_b: Roger that! I'll get myself ready now!
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_mc_jessica_23_b: Oh... Hi, Commander, you're here! Is that a gift for me?
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_mc_jessica_29_b: Roger that! I'll get myself ready now!
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_mc_lawrencet_5: Commander, new recruit Riven at your command!
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_mc_jessica_5: What's on your mind, Commander? You were staring off into the distance.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_mc_jessica_6: As you requested, I've investigated the city surroundings. The situation is worse than we expected.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_mc_jessica_9: Oh, sorry. Perhaps I was too pushy, but I want you to hear all about it.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_2_Dialog_mc_jessica: Calm down, Linda. Let's work together to restore production quickly, and then rescue Evelyn as soon as we can.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_3_Dialog_mc_jessica: Please, Linda. You must tell your Commander about this.
Tutorial_Tutorial_MiniMap_chat_5: They've besieged the Government and concentrated their forces outside of each capital to form a strong defensive line. Our connection with the Government is completely cut off!
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_mc_penelope_49_Zom: The map shows that Maria was abducted and brought to a biochemical base where the invaders conduct horrible experiments. I know that place but I'm afraid our existing troops are not enough to handle it.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_mc_lawrence_49_Zom: The map shows that Riven was abducted and brought to a biochemical base where the invaders conduct horrible experiments. I know that place but I'm afraid our existing troops are not enough to handle it.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_2_Dialog_mc_penelop: The invaders are secretly continuing the Pandora program and it seems they've kidnapped Evelyn to experiment on her. Saving Evelyn will be key to dismantling Pandora.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_2_Dialog_mc_lawrenc: The invaders are secretly continuing the Pandora program and it seems they've kidnapped Evelyn to experiment on her. Saving Evelyn will be key to dismantling Pandora.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_2_Dialog_mc_penelop: You're right, the invaders' zombie army is making my skin crawl. We await your orders, Commander, you can make us stronger!
Tutorial_New_Chapter_2_Dialog_mc_lawrenc: You're right, the invaders' zombie army is making my skin crawl. We await your orders, Commander, you can make us stronger!
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_mc_penelope_10_Zom: The invader's zombies are all around our base right now, and they could attack at any time!
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_mc_lawrence_10_Zom: The invader's zombies are all around our base right now, and they could attack at any time!
Tutorial_New_Chapter_4_Dialog_mc_penelop: We're finally ready. The only thing left to do is to search and destroy the enemy's Pandora army of biochemical soldiers.
Tutorial_New_Chapter_4_Dialog_mc_lawrenc: We're finally ready. The only thing left to do is to search and destroy the enemy's Pandora army of biochemical soldiers.
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_mc_penelope_54: Now's not the time for this, Commander. We need to save Maria first!
Tutorial_New_Fte_chat_mc_helene_54: Now's not the time for this, Commander. We need to save Helena first!
Tutorial_Synopsis_1: We encountered a mysterious merchant outside the city and purchased a large number of items, she gifted us <color=#69a9ff>{1}</color>.

Tutorial_Synopsis_3: {0} joined the guerrilla team in London to counterattack the invaders, and obtained the spoils of war <color=#69a9ff>{1}</color> on the battlefield.
Tutorial_Synopsis_4: {0} successfully intercepted <color=#69a9ff>{1}</color> during a surprise attack mission on the enemy's supply line in France.
Tutorial_Synopsis_5: {0} and companions agreed to go to the Peace Monument to offer flowers, and the monument guard gifted <color=#69a9ff>{1}</color>.
Tutorial_Synopsis_6: A Soviet pilot recounted to {0} his past battles with Pandora's forces. When parting, he gifted <color=#69a9ff>{1}</color>.
Tutorial_Synopsis_7: {0} provided the Allies with information about Pandora's imminent establishment of a prisoner of war camp in Europe, and the Allies gave <color=#69a9ff>{1}</color> as a token of gratitude.
Tutorial_Synopsis_8: {0} posted photos of the Invaders attacking the city scene on the news website and received a reward of <color=#69a9ff>{1}</color>.
Tutorial_Synopsis_9: {0} came across a small skirmish between the Allies and the Invaders while crossing the strait. They helped some injured crew members on the way, who gifted them <color=#69a9ff>{1}</color>.
Tutorial_Synopsis_10: In Czechoslovakia, {0} worked with the members of the S.P.E.A.R.S Squad. On a special night, she took out <color=#69a9ff>{1}</color> as a symbol of friendship.
Tutorial_Synopsis_11: During a frontline interview, {0} met Jenny. As we were leaving, we exchanged gifts, and her gift was <color=#69a9ff>{1}</color>.
Tutorial_Synopsis_12: {0} once met a pilot, we had a great chat. When we parted, he put <color=#69a9ff>{1}</color> in my bag.
Tutorial_Synopsis_13: {0} assisted the local cultural department in transporting these artworks out of the war zone. As a token of gratitude, they gifted <color=#69a9ff>{1}</color>.
Tutorial_Synopsis_14: During a tour of Paris with {0} and companions, it happened to be Victory Day. There were grand rallies throughout the city, and everyone at the rally was gifted <color=#69a9ff>{1}</color>.
Tutorial_Synopsis_15: {0} once took care of children who lost their homes due to the war at a relief center in London. In return, they gifted <color=#69a9ff>{1}</color>.
Tutorial_Intro_1: We discovered the <color=#D98417>{1}</color> hidden within the ancient castle while evading the search of Pandora's army.
Tutorial_Intro_2: With Christina's help, we have obtained <color=#BC59C6>{1}</color>.
Tutorial_Intro_3: We discovered <color=#BC59C6>{1}</color> in the temple in North Africa and brought it back to the base.
Tutorial_Intro_4: During a mission, we faced a fierce counterattack from the enemy and successfully intercepted <color=#D98417>{1}</color>.
Tutorial_Intro_5: I brought Medusa's research back to the base, and the scientists at the base developed a new <color=#D98417>{1}</color>.
Tutorial_Intro_6: During our escape, we discovered a mysterious base. After destroying the base, we obtained <color=#D98417>{1}</color>.
Tutorial_Intro_7: We helped a lady at the tavern, and she subsequently gifted us <color=#D98417>{1}</color>.
Tutorial_Intro_8: During our rest on the island, we found a chest. Upon opening, we discovered it was <color=#D98417>{1}</color>.
Tutorial_Intro_9: When we returned to the tavern in Brussels, the tavern owner handed over the <color=#BC59C6>{1}</color> left by Natasha.
Tutorial_Intro_10: When we passed by a village, the village chief gave us <color=#BC59C6>{1}</color> before we left.
Tutorial_Intro_11: We met a mysterious woman in a village, and she gave us a <color=#BC59C6>{1}</color>.
Tutorial_Intro_12: The Zombie Legion launched a total attack on Paris, and <color=#D98417>{1}</color> joined our resistance team.
Tutorial_Intro_13: We were attacked by Pandora's Legion, and <color=#D98417>{1}</color> suddenly appeared to rescue us.
Tutorial_Intro_14: I met <color=#D98417>{1}</color> and she joined our team. Friendship blossomed over a cup of wine, making our mission even more resolute.

Tutorial_Dialogue__11:
In order to evade the search of Pandora's army, I had to cross the forest to return to the base.
"Huh, why is there an ancient castle here?"
Tutorial_Dialogue__12: (Lights a torch and enters the ancient castle) "Cough cough, there's a hidden room here, I'll go in and take a look."
Tutorial_Dialogue__13: (Opens the wooden box) "Oh my god, there's actually a <color=#D98417>{1}</color> in here."
Tutorial_Dialogue__21: Christina, you have to help us. We are currently being pursued by Pandora's army, and our weapons are no match for theirs.
Tutorial_Dialogue__22: Christina: I'm in the middle of development. Give me a few days, and I can provide you with more powerful weapons.
Tutorial_Dialogue__23: A few days later, we obtained the <color=#BC59C6>{1}</color> researched by Christina and successfully repelled Pandora's army.
Tutorial_Dialogue__31: We were dispatched to North Africa to carry out a special mission and passed by an abandoned temple on the way.
Tutorial_Dialogue__32: We've all worked hard along the way, let's take a temporary rest in the temple.
Tutorial_Dialogue__33: (In the temple, an item on the altar has been shining) "There's actually a<color=#BC59C6>{1}</color> hidden here, we definitely won't lose in this joint battle!"
Tutorial_Dialogue__41: During a mission to raid Pandora's supply lines, intelligence indicated that the convoy contained a batch of materials we had never heard of.
Tutorial_Dialogue__42: We are determined to ambush on the way and successfully intercept all materials to be transported back to the rear.
Tutorial_Dialogue__43: After intense fighting, we successfully intercepted <color=#D98417>{1}</color>.
Tutorial_Dialogue__51: I am an agent of the Scarlet Raven, dispatched to Medusa for intelligence gathering. In an occupied laboratory, I discovered that they are conducting experiments unknown to the public.
Tutorial_Dialogue__52: I broke through the encirclement with the information of this research and returned to the base.
Tutorial_Dialogue__53: Our scientists have also broken through the technological defenses and researched the new <color=#D98417>{1}</color>.
Tutorial_Dialogue__61:
(We've disrupted Pandora's supply line and are being pursued by the Chimera troops.)
"Why is there a heavily guarded base here?"
Tutorial_Dialogue__62:
(So they were doing this here...)
After bringing back the data, we also developed {1}.
Tutorial_Dialogue__71: After the Biozone, we relaxed in a pub in Brussels, where someone was harassing a lady named Natasha.
Tutorial_Dialogue__72: We helped Natasha deal with her harasser on the way, and relaxed before leaving the pub.
Tutorial_Dialogue__73: Lady Natasha ran out to thank us and gave us a small gift. Open it and surprisingly it's <color=#D98417>{1}</color>.
Tutorial_Dialogue__81: A few days ago, we were dispatched to carry out a mission at sea. After completing the mission, we passed by a small island and took a short rest.
Tutorial_Dialogue__82: Clear skies and white clouds, golden beaches, everything is so peaceful. Since the war, it's rare to see such a wonderful scenery.
Tutorial_Dialogue__83: During the diving competition, I found a chest at the bottom of the sea. I salvaged the chest and opened it to find that it contained <color=#D98417>{1}</color>.
Tutorial_Dialogue__91: After completing the mission, we went to that pub in Brussels to relax.
Tutorial_Dialogue__92: The tavern owner brought out <color=#BC59C6>{1}</color>, saying it was left for us by the girl we rescued last time.
Tutorial_Dialogue__93: And it comes with a note: For Peace.
Tutorial_Dialogue__101: When we were in Paris, we joined the local S.P.E.A.R.S Squad. Due to a leak of intelligence, the squad was heavily hit by the rebels, with only a few scattered individuals managing to escape.
Tutorial_Dialogue__102: During our escape, we resupplied in a village and told the children there about the outside world.
Tutorial_Dialogue__103: When we were leaving, the village chief handed us a cloth bag to take with us. We opened it and found it was <color=#BC59C6>{1}</color>.
Tutorial_Dialogue__111: We passed through a village that was holding a celebration.
Tutorial_Dialogue__112: On the parade route, a mysterious woman suddenly tapped on my shoulder.
Tutorial_Dialogue__113: After I followed her, she handed me a big gift pack. Upon opening, it was <color=#BC59C6>{1}</color>. Turns out, there are also S.P.E.A.R.S Squad contacts here.
Tutorial_Dialogue__121: The Zombie Legion is besieging Paris, and we, along with the Minerva Squad, are desperately resisting the countless Zombie Legions, waiting for the support of the Allies. Suddenly, we saw <color=#F39C12>{1}</color>, she broke through from the right wing and joined us, her return became the turning point of victory.
Tutorial_Dialogue__131: On the streets, we encountered an attack from Pandora's Legion. In our moment of despair, <color=#F39C12>{1}</color> suddenly appeared, decisively standing in front of us, fighting against the assassins. Her courage and determination saved us, making me realize the value of friendship and help.
Tutorial_Dialogue__141: In a tavern in a strange town, I raised my glass in solitude. <color=#F39C12>{1}</color> sat by the bar, watching me. She came over and suggested we drink together. Our conversation became the start of our friendship, and upon hearing about our mission, she decided to join our team without hesitation. After this chance encounter in the tavern, our journey welcomed a new companion and was infused with new hope.
Tutorial_Dialogue__151: The submarine encountered a malfunction in the deep sea, and I was in a predicament. <color=#F39C12>{1}</color>'s mechanical talent enabled her to solve the critical problem and saved us. Out of gratitude, she decided to join our team. The experience of repairing the submarine became a bond between us and also strengthened our team.
Tutorial_Dialogue__161: We stumbled upon an injured kitten on the street. As we were at a loss, <color=#F39C12>{1}</color> approached and gently treated the kitten's wounds. In that moment, a special connection was established between us. She then expressed her wish to join our team, and her compassion and affability became an indispensable part of our team. A kitten linked our friendship, making our mission more meaningful.
Tutorial_Soldier_Submarine_1: The <color=#F39C12>Abyssal Pathfinder</color> is about to be completed, please go and inspect it, Commander!
Tutorial_Soldier_MaritimeBureau_1: Commander, we have successfully renovated the abandoned factory at the dock.
Tutorial_Soldier_MaritimeBureau_2: Next, the <color=#F39C12>Maritime Bureau</color> will settle here.
Tutorial_Soldier_MaritimeBureau_3: We will manage ships and weapons here.
Tutorial_Natasha_MaritimeBureau_2: Here, we can collectively view and manage all ships, including warships and submarines.
Tutorial_Natasha_MaritimeBureau_3: This is the <color=#F39C12>Weapon Factory</color>, the place where warship weapons are manufactured and managed.
Tutorial_Natasha_MaritimeBureau_4: Warship weapons can <color=#F39C12>significantly</color> enhance our combat capabilities, please be sure to pay attention to it.
Tutorial_Natasha_MaritimeBureau_5: Crafting weapons requires a variety of materials, please pay more attention to these spoils of war on the battlefield.
Tutorial_Natasha_MaritimeBureau_6: Furthermore, due to issues such as lost blueprints and manufacturing processes, workers cannot guarantee that every weapon produced will be identical. Please understand this point.
Tutorial_Synopsis_16: The S.P.E.A.R.S were ordered to infiltrate deep into enemy lines, successfully destroying Pandora's secret base. The Allies commended their heroic actions and sent a <color=#69a9ff>{1}</color> as a reward.
Tutorial_Synopsis_17: In the gloomy counterattack, the S.P.E.A.R.S bravely raided the enemy's artillery position, and finally discovered a <color=#69a9ff>{1}</color>, providing the Allies with the urgently needed support.
Tutorial_Synopsis_18: The Allies are in a critical situation, the S.P.E.A.R.S fought day and night, and finally successfully recaptured the enemy's <color=#69a9ff>{1}</color>, providing valuable logistical support for the Allies.
Tutorial_Synopsis_19: In a decisive battle, the S.P.E.A.R.S successfully destroyed Pandora's secret lab. The Allies sent them a highly precious <color=#69a9ff>{1}</color> to commend their victory and contribution.
Tutorial_Synopsis_20: In the midst of the raging war, the S.P.E.A.R.S successfully broke through the enemy blockade and discovered a <color=#69a9ff>{1}</color>. The Allies highly praised their spirit of exploration and looked forward to their future achievements.
Tutorial_Synopsis_21: The S.P.E.A.R.S bravely resisted the fierce attack of the Chimera, successfully protecting the important resource points of the Allies, and won a <color=#69a9ff>{1}</color> reward.
Tutorial_Synopsis_22: At a critical moment, the S.P.E.A.R.S successfully decrypted Pandora's communication codes, providing important intelligence for the Allies. The Allies gave them a <color=#69a9ff>{1}</color> as a reward.
Tutorial_Synopsis_23: The S.P.E.A.R.S ventured deep into enemy territory and successfully rescued a group of imprisoned Allied prisoners of war. The Allies awarded them a medal of honor for their rescue operation and provided <color=#69a9ff>{1}</color> and other combat readiness supplies.
Tutorial_Synopsis_24: Allied intelligence indicated that Pandora planned to attack the Allied stronghold. The S.P.E.A.R.S urgently launched a defense and ultimately successfully thwarted the enemy's attack. The Allies sent them a <color=#69a9ff>{1}</color> for their heroic behavior.
Tutorial_Synopsis_25: The S.P.E.A.R.S carried out a mission deep behind enemy lines, successfully recapturing an important map. The Allies highly praised their intelligence work and gifted them a practical <color=#69a9ff>{1}</color>.
Tutorial_Intro_17: In order to resist the invasion of Pandora's forces, we went to the Lost City according to the intelligence and found the <color=#D98417>{1}</color>.
Tutorial_Dialogue__171: Commanders, the invasion of Pandora's forces is unstoppable. Intelligence reports mention a scientist in the Lost City who once researched experimental weapons to combat zombies. We need to find that weapon immediately.
Tutorial_Dialogue__172: "This is the place, proceed with caution, we don't know what we might encounter."
Tutorial_Dialogue__173: "Be careful, this place is full of zombie mutants. Everyone, clear out the zombies and find weapons."
Tutorial_Dialogue__174: The S.P.E.A.R.S kept pushing forward and discovered the innermost laboratory in the lab center.
Tutorial_Dialogue__175: "According to the intelligence, this is it. Immediately send the <color=#D98417>{1}</color> back to the base, our hope lies here."
Tutorial_Marjorie_Museum_01: Commander, our Museum is now open for business.
Tutorial_Marjorie_Museum_02: The museum is a place to collect and manage artifacts. Let's go in and take a look.
Tutorial_Marjorie_Museum_03: Please click the button to unlock the Museum.
Tutorial_Marjorie_Museum_04: Welcome to the Museum, Commander. Let me give you a brief introduction.
Tutorial_Marjorie_Museum_05: The Museum is a place for collecting and managing Artifacts. All Artifacts discovered by Commanders during their world exploration will be sent to the Museum for centralized management.
Tutorial_Marjorie_Museum_06: Artifacts can provide us with various boosts, helping us gain an advantage in combat.
Tutorial_Marjorie_Museum_07: The museum has just opened and is still empty. Come on, let's go to the Artifact Market to find some artifacts.
Tutorial_Marjorie_Museum_08: Good News! We have acquired our first Artifact.
Tutorial_Marjorie_Museum_09: Tap the artifact to view its details.
Tutorial_Marjorie_Museum_10: You can view the details of the artifacts here. Of course, you can also enhance the artifacts here.
Tutorial_Marjorie_Museum_11: After collecting a certain amount of Artifact Fragments and Ancient Books during world exploration, Commanders can enhance their Artifacts.
Tutorial_Marjorie_Museum_12: For more detailed rules, please visit the Museum Rules page.
Tutorial_Marjorie_Museum_13: Here you can view the overview of boosts provided by the current artifacts.
Tutorial_Marjorie_Museum_14: Go collect more artifacts to gain even stronger boosts.
Tutorial_Marjorie_Museum_15: Welcome to the Exhibition Hall. Let me give a brief introduction.
Tutorial_Marjorie_Museum_16: The commander can display collected artifacts in the exhibition hall for visitors to admire.
Tutorial_Marjorie_Museum_17: The higher the rarity of the exhibited artifacts, the more popular they are with visitors, and the higher the revenue of the exhibition hall.
Tutorial_Marjorie_Museum_18: Your daily income will be settled in the form of Gold at 00:00 UTC the next day. Please remember to collect it.
Tutorial_Marjorie_Museum_19: Additionally, the artifacts on display will provide extra exhibition boosts. This is very important.
Tutorial_Marjorie_Museum_20: Next, please display an artifact in a booth in the exhibition hall.
Tutorial_Marjorie_Museum_21: Please select the artifacts to exhibit.
Tutorial_Marjorie_Museum_22: The artifact has been successfully displayed in the exhibition hall!
Tutorial_Marjorie_Museum_23: It seems you have already gained a basic understanding of the Museum and Artifacts. Next, please explore the secrets of the Artifacts on your own.
Tutorial_Soldier_Ship5_01: Report Commander, our new warship has been completed, go check it out!
Tutorial_Soldier_Ship5_02: Montana-class battleship (BB-67 Montana), standard displacement of 63,221 long tons, full load displacement of 70,965 long tons, length of 921 feet, width of 121 feet.
Tutorial_Soldier_Ship5_03: Equipped with powerful weapon systems, the protection against torpedoes and artillery is also greatly enhanced.
Tutorial_Soldier_Ship5_04: May it accompany you to victory in every battle, invincible and unstoppable.
Tutorial_return_talk_01: Commander, you're finally back! The front lines have been waiting for you.
Tutorial_return_talk_02: Although the situation has changed somewhat during your absence... the good news is that your base has not stopped moving forward.
Tutorial_return_talk_03: Allow me to report on the achievements we have made during your absence.
Tutorial_return_talk_05: While you were away, the construction workers did not stop working for a single day.
Tutorial_return_talk_06: These are the results of their hard work during this time.
Tutorial_return_talk_08: The researchers have never slacked off either. They have been advancing various technologies day and night, and now multiple technologies have achieved breakthroughs.
Tutorial_return_talk_10: The arsenals have been operating at full capacity. All combat units have been replenished and are ready for battle at any time.
Tutorial_return_talk_12: Click here to learn more about exclusive return benefits.
Tutorial_return_talk_13: May you triumph once again, Commander!
